script1.title: Growing Up and Losing Childhood Simplicity
script1.content: Growing up ane process lo manam chala things vadileyalsi vasthundi.Chinnappudu unna aa carefree feeling,evariki em anipisthe adi cheppadam,evariki em kavali ante adi adagadam...ivi anni slowly maripothayi.Manam react cheyakamundu think cheyadam nerchukuntam.Emotions ni control cheskovadam nerchukuntam.Konni sarlu idi necessary,kaani konni sarlu naaku aa simplicity kosam miss avuthundi.Chinnappudu oka chinna toy kosam full ga happy ayyevallam.Ippudu chinna chinna things valla happy avvadam kashtam,endukante manam anni sarlu next thing gurinchi think chesthu untam.Kaani naaku artham ayyindi,growing up ante aa innocence ni completely lose avvadam kaadu.Adi somewhere lopala survive avuthundi.Manam konchem effort chesthe,chinna chinna moments lo malli aa simple happiness ni feel cheyachu.Oka rain,oka old song,oka childhood friend tho conversation...ivi anni malli aa feeling ni thecchi pedathayi.Anduke nenu ippudu try chesthunna,every time adult ga behave cheyalsina avasaram ledu ani.Konchem sarlu simple ga,free ga feel avvadam kuda important.

script2.title: Career Pressure and Feeling Behind
script2.content:
Naaku life lo biggest confusion career gurinchi anipisthundi.Chinnappudu future lo em avvali ani adigithe easyga answer cheppevallam.Doctor avvali,engineer avvali,police avvali ani edo okati cheppevallam.Appudu aa answer correct aa wrong aa ani think cheyalsina avasaram undedi kaadu.Kaani college ki vachina tarvata situation completely change ayipoyindi.Ippudu career ante just oka job kaadu.Job vachina tarvata salary entha?Growth ela untundi?Future securega untunda?Manaki interest untunda?Work pressure ela untundi?Ila chala questions vastayi.Inka biggest problem comparison.Evaraina mana age lo success ayithe,manaki immediatega oka thought vastundi.Nenu enduku ila unna?Nenu enduku inka achieve cheyaledu?Evaraina internship chesthe manam tension padatham.Evaraina job crack chesthe manam mana preparation gurinchi doubt chestham.Kaani recentga oka thing realize ayyanu.Everyone has a different starting point.Konthamandiki right guidance earlyga dorukutundi.Konthamandiki opportunities ekkuvaga vastayi.Konthamandiki financial support untundi.Inkonthamandi everything selfga figure out cheskovali.Anduke two people ni directga compare cheyadam correct kaadu.Sometimes manam behind unnattu anipisthundi.Kaani behind ante exactly emiti?Evaru decide chesaru manam ee age ki ee position lo undali ani?Life ki universal timetable emaina unda?Twenty-two ki job ravali,twenty-five ki settle avvali ani rules evaru create chesaru?

Nenu ippudu aa pressure ni konchem reduce cheskovali anukuntunnanu.Naaku immediatega entire future teliyalsina avasaram ledu.Ippudu naaku next step teliste chalu.Ee roju oka skill improve cheyali.Repu oka problem solve cheyali.Ala slowly move avvali.

Success ante always first place lo undadam kaadu.Mana own journey lo continue avvadam.Konni days fastga move avutham.Konni days slowga move avutham.Konni days completega stop ayipotham.Kaani stop ayina tarvata malli start cheyagaligite adhe important.

Naaku ippatiki career gurinchi fear undi.Clarity kuda completega ledu.Kaani oka vishayam clearga telusu.Nenu vere vallani chusi naa journey ni judge cheyakudadu.Naa speed naadi.Naa path naadi.Maybe nenu konchem latega reach avvachu.Kaani reach ayina place naaku meaningfulga unte,chalu.

Ippudu nenu career gurinchi inko important thing kuda add cheyalanukuntunnanu.Mistakes cheyadam kuda process lo part.Nenu prathi decision perfect ga theesukovali ani try chesthe,edaina start cheyadaniki kuda bhayapadatanu.Kaani chala successful people kuda mundu wrong paths try chesi,tarvata correct direction kanukkunnaru.Anduke nenu ippudu oka wrong choice cheste,adi naa career ni permanently damage chesthundi ani anukovadam ledu.Prathi experience,adi job aina,internship aina,leda oka failed attempt aina,naaku edo oka thing nerpisthundi.Naaku ippudu vere vallatho compare cheyakunda,naa own progress ni track cheyadam nerchukuntunnanu.Last year nenu ekkada unnanu,ee year ekkada unnanu ani chusthe,chinna progress aina kanipisthundi.Adi naaku confidence isthundi.Career ante oka straight line kaadu.Konni turns untayi,konni delays untayi.Kaani manam consistent ga try chesthu unte,eventually correct place ki cherukuntam ani nenu believe chesthunnanu.

script3.title: Family Expectations and My Own Dreams
script3.content:
Family gurinchi think chesthe naaku mixed feelings vastayi.Parents mana kosam chala chestaru.Valla sacrifices manam completega understand cheyalem.Chinnappudu vallaki manam just children.Kaani slowly grow ayyaka artham avuthundi,vallu mana future kosam entha think chestunnaro.

Anduke vallani disappoint cheyakudadu ani manaki anipisthundi.Vallu oka career suggest chesthe,manam immediatega no ani cheppalem.Vallu oka decision manaki better ani anukunte,manam kuda doubt padatham.

Kaani konnisarlu mana dreams differentga untayi.Mana interest oka field lo untundi.Vallaki vere field securega anipinchachu.Appudu conflict create avuthundi.Evaru wrong ani cheppadam easy kaadu.

Parents perspective kuda manam understand cheyali.Vallu mana generation lo grow avvaledu.Vallaki unna experiences different.Mana generation ki technology undi,more career options unnayi,work culture differentga undi.Anduke vallaki mana choices sometimes riskyga anipinchavachu.

Ade time lo,manam kuda mana life ni completely vere vallaki handover cheyakudadu.Eventually aa career lo work cheyalsindi maname.Aa life ni live cheyalsindi maname.Anduke mana decisions lo mana interest kuda undali.

Nenu anukuntunnadi parents tho fight cheyadam kaadu.Matladadam.Understand cheyadam.Explain cheyadam.Vallaki naa dream enduku importanto cheppali.Vallaki unna fear enti ani adigi telusukovali.

Sometimes parents no ani cheppina,konchem time tarvata understand cheskovachu.Sometimes manam kuda valla point realize avvachu.The important thing is communication.

Family expectations valla manam mana happiness ni completely sacrifice cheyakudadu.Alage mana dreams kosam family feelings ni ignore cheyakudadu.Balance important.

Naaku anipisthundi,parents mana enemies kaadu.Vallu strictga behave chesina,most of the time valla intention mana future gurinche untundi.Manam kuda mana side ni maturega explain cheyali.

Finally,success ante parents ni satisfy cheyadam okkate kaadu.Mana life ni meaningfulga build cheyadam kuda.Success vachina tarvata mana family happyga undali,manam kuda peacefulga undali.

Family expectations gurinchi inko important point naaku recent ga artham ayyindi.Time anedi chala healing chestundi.Nenu oka decision teesukunnappudu parents ki nachakapoyina,vallu immediately accept cheyakapoyina,konchem time ivvadam important.Manam patience tho vallaki explain chesthu unte,slowly vallu kuda open ga think cheyadam start chestaru.Alage nenu kuda vallu chెppedi motham ignore cheyakunda,edaina valid point unte accept cheyadaniki ready ga undali.Family ante oka team laga pani cheyali,competition laga kaadu.Prathi generation ki own struggles untayi,own fears untayi.Manam aa fears ni understand chesukunte,conflict tగ్గుతుంది.Naaku ippudu anipisthundi,perfect family ante prathi decision lo agree ayye family kaadu.Disagreements unna,respect tho handle cheyagalige family.Nenu naa dream follow avvadaniki vallu support cheyakapoyina,vallu naa wellbeing gurinche worry padutunnaru ani gurthu pettukuntanu.Adi naaku vallatho patience tho matladataniki help chestundi.

script4.title: Failure, Rejection and Starting Again
script4.content:
Failure gurinchi naa thinking chala change ayyindi.Earlier failure ante something bad ani anukunevadini.Oka exam lo marks takkuva vaste,naa ability saripodu anukunevadini.Oka opportunity miss aithe,naa luck bad ani anukunevadini.Oka person nannu reject chesthe,nalo edo problem undani think chesevadini.

Kaani life lo konchem experience vachina tarvata artham ayyindi.Failure ante final answer kaadu.Oka result maatrame.

Oka interview lo reject ayyam anukundam.Appudu two options untayi.First option,I am not good enough ani decide cheskovadam.Second option,what went wrong ani think chesi improve avvadam.

First option easyga anipisthundi.Endukante manam responsibility avoid cheyachu.Kaani second option difficult.Manam ekkada weakga unnamo accept cheyali.

Konni failures mana mistake valla vastayi.Konni circumstances valla vastayi.Konni times manam correct person ayina,correct time kaakapovachu.Anduke every rejection means we are bad ani kaadu.

Naaku oka thing chala importantga anipisthundi.We should not turn one failure into our identity.Nenu fail ayyanu anedi oka situation.Nenu failure ne anedi identity.Ee difference chala important.

Manam padipothe hurt avvachu.Manam konchem time teesukovachu.Adi okay.Kaani forever akkade undipokudadu.

Sometimes restart cheyadam first attempt kanna difficult.Endukante first time hope untundi.Second time previous failure memory untundi.Aina malli start cheyadam important.

Nenu ippudu failures ni completely enjoy chesthunnanu ani kaadu.Failure ippatiki hurt chestundi.Kaani ippudu danini differentga chusthunnanu.Oka failure naaku something teach chesthe,adi completely waste kaadu.Oka rejection naaku better preparation nerpisthe,adi useless kaadu.

Maybe success ante never failing kaadu.Failure ayina tarvata malli try cheyadam.

Life lo enni times manam padipoyam anedi important kaadu.Enni times malli nilabaddam anedi important.

Anduke ippudu edaina fail ayina,konchem time feel avvachu,konchem hurt avvachu.Kaani finalga nenu malli try chestanu ani naaku nenu cheppukuntanu.Because one bad result cannot decide my entire life.

Failure gurinchi nenu ippudu inko angle nunchi kuda chustunnanu.Prathi person life lo edo oka point lo fail avutharu.Chala successful vallu కూడా,vallu public గా cheppకపోయినా,chala rejections face chesi unnaru.Manam social media lo vallaki unna success matrame chusthaam,vallaki unna struggle chudam.Anduke comparison chesukunnappudu manaki thakkuva anipisthundi.Kaani reality lo prathi vallu vallla own timeline lo unnaru.Naaku ippudu edaina fail ayithe,first konchem time teesukuntanu feel avvadaniki.Tarvata specific ga em jarigindo analyze chestanu.Naa effort correct ga unda,naa approach correct ga unda,leda circumstances naaku control lo lేvа ani chudataanu.Ee process valla next time betterga prepare avvachu.Failure ni personal insult laga theesukokunda,oka feedback laga theesukovadam nerchukuntunnanu.Adi easy kaadu,kaani practice tho better avuthundi.Finally nenu artham chesukunnadi enti ante,try cheyakunda undadam kanna,try chesi fail avvadam better,endukante try chesinappudu nenu edo oka thing nerchukuntanu.

script5.title: Finding Yourself and Living at Your Own Pace
script5.content:
Konni times naaku biggest question career kaadu,money kaadu,future kuda kaadu.Nenu actually evarini ani.

Manam life lo chala roles play chestham.Studentga untam,friendga untam,family memberga untam,employee ga untam.Kaani ee roles anni pakkana pedithe,nenu actualga em kavali ani manam chala rarely ask cheskuntam.

Others expectations prakaram life lead chesthu unte,slowly mana own voice vinipinchadam taggipothundi.Evaraina suggestion isthe follow avutham.Evaraina compare chesthe tension padatham.Evaraina success chupisthe mana goals change cheskuntam.

Oka stage lo naaku artham ayyindi.Nenu vere vallani impress cheyadaniki life lead chesthe,eventually nenu unhappy avvachu.

Anduke ippudu konchem differentga think cheyali anukuntunnanu.Naaku actually em ishtam?Nenu em chesthe time fastga pass ayipothundi?Nenu em nerchukovalani genuinely anukuntunnanu?Evaru chudakapoyina nenu em cheyadaniki readyga untanu?

Ee questions ki answers immediatega raavu.Kaani ask cheskovadam important.

Finding yourself ante oka single day lo sudden realization raavadam kaadu.It is a slow process.Rojurojuki manam konchem konchemga mana gurinchi telusukuntam.

Oka experience manaki nachani thing ni chupisthundi.Inko experience manaki mana strength teliyajesthundi.Oka failure mana weakness chupisthundi.Oka friendship mana values teliyajesthundi.Ala slowly manam evaramo understand cheskuntam.

Ippudu nenu perfect person avvali ani anukovadam ledu.Nenu every day better version avvali ani anukuntunnanu.

Konni days productivega untayi.Konni days complete waste laga anipisthayi.Konni days confidentga untam.Konni days self-doubt tho struggle avutham.Adi life lo normal part.

Naa pace slowga unte slowga vellanu.Naa path konchem differentga unte differentga vellanu.Endukante eventually nenu vere vallatho race cheyadam ledu.Naa life ni nene live chesthunnanu.

Maybe life lo biggest success entante,manam oka stage ki vachi,naa life perfect kaakapoyina,idi naa life,naaku idi nachuthundi ani honestly cheppagalagadam.

Adi naaku ippudu real success laga anipisthundi.

### **2.Indian Culture, Traditions and Modern Life**

Finding yourself gurinchi nenu inko thing add cheyalanukuntunnanu.Solitude ki chala importance undi ee process lo.Manam constantly evariko evariko tho connected ga unte,mana own thoughts ni vinipettukovadam kashtam avuthundi.Konchem time alone gadipithe,manaki nijamga em kavalo clear ga artham avuthundi.Nenu ippudu prathi roju konni minutes naa kosam teesukuntunnanu,phone pakkana pettesi,just naa thoughts తో undataniki.Andulo konni sarlu confusion vastundi,konni sarlu clarity vastundi.Rendu kuda okay.Alage journaling kuda naaku chala help chesindi.Naa feelings ni rాsi pedithe,vaati venuka unna pattern kanipisthundi.Nenu enduku konni situations lo stress avuthanno,enduku konni things naaku genuinely happiness istayo,slowly artham avuthundi.Self-discovery ante oka destination kaadu,oka continuous journey.Naaku ippudu artham ayyindi,nenu evarini అవ్వాలో ఆ answer ippudే dorakakapoina parledu.Prathi year konchem konchemగా nenu naa gurinchi nerchukuntune untanu.

script6.category: Indian Culture, Traditions and Modern Life
script6.title: Indian Culture in Everyday Life
script6.content:
India gurinchi alochisthe first ga naaku gurthochedi mana diversity.India lo different languages,different religions,different foods,different clothes,different festivals mariyu different traditions unnayi.Kaani interesting thing enti ante,ivi anni mana daily life lo chala naturally part aipoyayi.

Mana culture ante kevalam festivals vachinappudu follow chese things kaadu.Mana daily habits lo kuda culture untundi.Intlo elders ni respect cheyadam,guest intiki vaste vallani welcome cheyadam,family tho kalisi food tinadam,important occasions lo relatives tho kalavadam...ivi anni mana lifestyle lo common ga untayi.

Chinnappudu manam ee things enduku chestunnamo ekkuvaga alochincham.Avi just normal ani anukuntam.Kaani age perigina tarvata observe chesthe,aa small habits venuka oka meaning untundi.Elders ni respect cheyadam vallaki age ekkuva kabatti maatrame kaadu.Valla experience nunchi manam nerchukovachu ane feeling kuda untundi.

Alage mana families lo food ki chala importance untundi.Evaraina intiki vaste,meeru food tinnara ani adagadam almost automatic ga untundi.Guest hungry ga undakudadu ane feeling chala Indian families lo untundi.Food ni share cheyadam kuda oka way of showing care.

Mana clothing lo kuda culture kanipisthundi.Saree,kurta,dhoti,lehenga mariyu different regional dresses ki own styles untayi.Festival leda wedding vachinappudu traditional dress vesukovadam chala common.Ippudu modern clothes daily life lo common ayina,traditional clothes ki special occasions lo inka importance undi.

Mana language kuda culture lo important part.Mana mother tongue lo matladinappudu emotions konchem different ga express avuthayi.Oka language lo unna jokes,phrases,stories mariyu expressions aa culture ni reflect chestayi.Anduke mother tongue ni preserve cheyadam important.

Kaani culture ante anni old things ni same way lo continue cheyadam ani nenu anukonu.Time tho paatu culture kuda change avuthundi.Some traditions continue avuthayi,kotha habits add avuthayi,konni things slowly disappear avuthayi.Adi natural.

Naaku Indian culture lo nachina main thing enti ante,modern life tho traditional life kalisi undatam.Morning traditional festival celebrate chesi,afternoon online meeting attend avvachu.Evening family tho traditional food tinesi,night international movie chudachu.Ivi contradictory things kaavu.Ivi modern Indian life lo normal part.

Anduke culture ante past lo unna oka thing kaadu.Culture ante manam ippudu ela live chesthunnamo,em values follow chesthunnamo,em memories next generation ki pass chesthunnamo ane process.

Indian culture gurinchi inko thing naaku importantగా anipisthundi,adi mana hospitality.Evarైనా mana intiki వచ్చినప్పుడు,manam vallaki best treatment ivvadaniki try chestham.Adi oka relative aina,friend aina,leda kotha person aina,warm ga welcome cheyadam mana culture lo deep ga embed ayyi undi.Alage mana joint family system kuda special.Ippudu chala families nuclear ayina,relatives tho connection maatrام strong ga untundi.Marriages,functions,festivals valla extended family motham kalusukune chance dorukutundi.Ee gatherings lo unna bonding,oka different type of support system istundi.Chinnappudu cousins tho spend chesina time,uncles aunts daggara nunchi vinna stories,ivi anni oka rich cultural memory create chestayi.Naaku anipisthundi,ee connections valla mana society lo oka sense of belonging untundi.Manam individual గా matrame కాదు,oka larger community లో part గా feel avutham.Ade Indian culture yokka real strength.

script7.category: Indian Culture, Traditions and Modern Life
script7.title: Festivals and the Feeling of Togetherness
script7.content:
India lo festivals ki unna importance chala special ga untundi.Almost every region ki,community ki,season ki oka special celebration untundi.Festival peru different ga undochu,celebrate chese method different ga undochu,food different ga undochu.Kaani almost anni festivals lo oka common feeling untundi.People coming together.

Sankranti,Pongal,Onam,Baisakhi,Diwali,Holi,Ugadi,Eid,Christmas mariyu chala other festivals different parts lo celebrate chestaru.Oka festival vachinappudu atmosphere motham change aipothundi.Intlo cleaning start chestaru,decorations chestaru,new clothes konukkuntaru,special food prepare chestaru.

Chinnappudu festival ante mostly holiday,new clothes,sweets mariyu fun anipisthundi.Kaani age perigina tarvata festival lo unna emotional side kuda artham avuthundi.Relatives vere cities lo unna kuda festival kosam home ki ravadaniki try chestaru.Family members kalustaru.Friends ni kalustam.Neighbours tho food share chestam.

Konni festivals agriculture tho connected ga untayi.Harvest complete ayina tarvata people celebrate chestaru.Konni festivals religious beliefs tho connected ga untayi.Konni festivals season change ni represent chestayi.Ee differences anni unna,celebration people ni connect chestundi.

Naaku festivals lo food part kuda chala interesting ga anipisthundi.Prathi festival ki special dishes untayi.Intlo aa food prepare chesthunappudu childhood memories gurthostayi.Grandmother chesina sweets,amma chesina special dish leda festival roju family tho kalisi tinnadi...ivi years tarvata kuda gurthuntayi.

Modern life lo manam chala busy aipoyam.Andaru jobs,studies,business mariyu other responsibilities tho busy ga untaru.Sometimes family tho proper ga matladataniki kuda time undadu.Kaani festival vachinappudu at least oka roju andariki kalisi undadaniki reason dorukutundi.

Social media valla ippudu vere regions festivals kuda easy ga chudagalugutunnam.Oka state lo jarige celebration ni inkoka state lo unna person kuda videos dwara chudagaladu.Ala cultural knowledge spread avuthundi.

Kaani festivals ni just photos kosam celebrate cheyakunda,vati meaning kuda understand cheskunte inka better ga untundi.Endukante oka tradition venuka oka story undochu,oka value undochu,oka history undochu.

Naaku anipisthundi festivals mana culture ni alive ga unchutayi.Generation maruthunna,technology maruthunna,life style maruthunna,festivals malli malli mana roots ni gurthu chestayi.

Festivals gurinchi inko interesting point enti ante,ivi mana calendar ni naturally divide chestayi.Prathi konni months ki oka festival vachi,manaki oka break istundi daily routine nunchi.Ee breaks lo family tho reconnect avvadam,relax avvadam,mana energy ni recharge chesukovadam jarugutundi.Chinnapudu festival ante holidays and sweets matrame anipinchina,ippudu artham avutundi ee celebrations mana mental wellbeing kosam kuda ఎంత useful ani.Alage festivals valla local economy ki కూడా benefit untundi.Small vendors,artisans,decorators,sweet shops andarikీ ee season lో ekkuva business వస్తుంది.Modern life lో chala busy గా unna,festival వచ్చిన appudu prathi oka family konchem time teesukuni ee traditions ni continue chestundi.Nenu anukuntunnadi,festivals kevalam past ni celebrate cheయడం కాదు.Ivi present లో మనలni togetherగా tీసుకొచ్చే oka bridge.Future generations కి కూడా ivi అలానే continue avvalani ఆశిస్తున్నాను.

script8.category: Indian Culture, Traditions and Modern Life
script8.title: Food, Clothing and Regional Traditions
script8.content:
Indian culture gurinchi matladetappudu food mariyu clothing gurinchi mention cheyakunda undalem.Endukante mana regional identity lo food mariyu traditional clothing ki chala important place undi.

India lo oka state nunchi inkoka state ki vellina,food completely change avvachu.South lo rice,dosa,idli,sambar lanti foods common ga untayi.North lo roti,paratha,paneer mariyu different gravies popular ga untayi.Coastal areas lo seafood ekkuva untundi.Some regions lo spicy food famous ga untundi.Inkoka region lo sweets special ga untayi.

Interesting thing enti ante,food just taste kosam develop avvaledu.Akkada unna climate,available crops,local ingredients mariyu old traditions food meeda influence chesayi.Anduke oka region food ni understand cheyali ante,aa place gurinchi kuda konchem understand cheyali.

Mana food lo spices ki kuda special role undi.Turmeric,chilli,cumin,coriander,cardamom mariyu chala spices generations nunchi cooking lo use chestunnam.Ippudu modern cooking methods vachina,traditional recipes inka chala homes lo continue avuthunnayi.

Clothing kuda same.A different region ki vellina,traditional dress styles change avuthayi.Saree ni different places lo different ways lo wear chestaru.Kurta,dhoti,lehenga mariyu other traditional clothes ki kuda regional variations untayi.

Ippudu modern India lo western clothing daily life lo common aipoyindi.Office ki formal clothes,casual outings ki jeans leda other modern clothes vesukuntam.Kaani wedding leda festival vachinappudu traditional clothes ki malli importance vastundi.

Naaku idi chala interesting ga anipisthundi.Mana generation tradition ni completely leave cheyaledu.Alage old lifestyle ni completely follow kuda cheyatledu.We are somewhere in between.

Food lo kuda same situation.International food try chestam.Pizza,burger,pasta lantivi enjoy chestam.Kaani next day intlo biryani,dosa leda traditional food kosam wait chestam.

Culture exactly ila evolve avuthundi.Kotha things accept chestam,old things lo manaki important anipinchevi continue chestam.

Anduke regional food mariyu clothing ni just fashion leda taste ga chudakunda,vatilo unna history and identity ni kuda appreciate cheyali.

Oka place ki travel chesinappudu local food try cheyadam,local dress observe cheyadam,local traditions gurinchi telusukovadam valla India entha diverse ga undo inka better ga understand cheyagalugutham.

Food mariyu clothing gurinchి inko point naaku importantగా అనిపిస్తుంది,adi ee traditions ela preserve avutayo ane question.Ippudu chala urban families lో traditional recipes slowly marచిపోతున్నాయి,endukante fast food and ready-made options easyగా available.Kaani konni families intentionally grandmother recipes ni రాసి pettukuంటున్నారు,వాటిని kids కి teach chేస్తున్నారు.Adi oka beautiful effort ani naaku anipisthundi.Alage regional handloom industries కి కూడా support avasaram.Chala చేతి పని artisans slowly ee mass production tо compete cheయలేకపోతున్నారు.Manam consciously local mariyు handmade products konte,ee traditions bratikే chance ekkuva untundi.Travel chేసినప్పుడు local food try cheయడం,local markets support cheయడం చిన్న steps లాగా అనిపించినా,వాటి impact పెద్దది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,culture ni preserve cheయడం అంటే మ్యూజియంలో పెట్టడం కాదు,daily life లో active గా continue cheయడం.

script9.category: Indian Culture, Traditions and Modern Life
script9.title: Language, Art and Traditions Passed Through Generations
script9.content:
Indian culture lo language ki chala deep connection undi.Mana country lo chala languages matladataru.Prathi language ki own stories,poems,songs,jokes mariyu expressions untayi.

Mother tongue lo manam emotions ni chala natural ga express chestam.Konni words ki direct English translation unna,aa word venuka unna feeling same ga convey avvakapovachu.Anduke language anedi communication tool maatrame kaadu,cultural identity kuda.

Grandparents generation ni observe chesthe idi inka clear ga kanipisthundi.Vallu old stories cheptaru,traditional songs paadataru,old sayings use chestaru.Vallaki telisina konni stories books lo kuda dorakakapovachu.Because avi generations nunchi oral ga pass ayyayi.

Mana traditional arts kuda alage continue ayyayi.Kuchipudi,Bharatanatyam,Kathak,Odissi,Kathakali mariyu different folk dances just entertainment kaadu.Vatilo stories,history,music mariyu traditions untayi.

Music lo kuda different regions ki different styles unnayi.Traditional instruments,folk songs mariyu classical music centuries nunchi develop ayyayi.Ippudu modern music tho mix ayina traditional influence inka vinipisthundi.

Kaani oka challenge kuda undi.Modern generation chala busy ga undi.Younger people ki traditional arts nerchukune time lekapovachu.Some languages kuda daily usage lo konchem taggipothunnayi.

Anduke traditions ni next generation ki introduce cheyadam important.Adi force cheyadam kaadu.Vati story cheppali,vati meaning explain cheyali,interest create cheyali.

Technology ikkada chala help cheyagaladu.Oka old folk song ni record chesi preserve cheyavachu.Oka traditional dance performance ni video ga save cheyavachu.Oka local story ni digital format lo store cheyavachu.

Ante technology tradition ki enemy ani kaadu.Technology ni correct ga use chesthe tradition ni future ki carry cheyadaniki help chestundi.

Naaku anipisthundi,oka generation nunchi inkoka generation ki culture transfer avvadam automatic ga jaragadu.Manam conscious ga share cheyali.

Mana grandparents daggara unna stories vini record cheyadam,parents daggara unna recipes nerchukovadam,mana mother tongue lo matladatam,local festivals participate cheyadam...ivi chinna things laga kanipinchina,actually culture ni continue chese ways.

Culture alive ga undali ante people danini practice cheyali.Remember cheyadam maatrame kaadu,live cheyali.

Language mariyu arts gurinchi inko thing cheppalanukuంటున్నాను.Ippudu chala kids intlo mother tongue kanna English lో ekkuva comfortable గా untunnaru.Adi wrong kaadu,English avasaram,kaani mother tongue ni neglect cheయడం oka loss.Nenu try chేస్తున్నాను intlo Telugu లోనే matladataniki,kotha words nerchukovataniki,traditional songs vinataniki.Grandparents daggara unna vocabulary,proverbs,expressions ivanni oka rich resource,vaatini manam use cheyakapothe slowly disappear ayipothayi.Alage classical arts nerchukovadam ki time avasaram,kaani ippudu chala online resources available unnayi.Konni platforms free గా dance,music tutorials istunnayi.Interest unte ఎవరైనా nerchukovачchu.Naaku anipisthundi,prathi person classical dancer avvalsina avasaram ledu,kaani basic appreciation undali.Oka concert ki వెళ్ళడం,oka traditional performance చూడడం,ఇవి కూడా cultural continuity లో part.Language and art bratikitే,culture bratukutundి.

script10.category: Indian Culture, Traditions and Modern Life
script10.title: Tradition and Modern India
script10.content:
Ippudu mana generation ni chusthe,traditional culture mariyu modern lifestyle rendu kalisi kanipisthayi.Oka side technology,AI,social media,online education mariyu modern jobs unnayi.Inko side festivals,family traditions,regional food,languages mariyu old customs unnayi.

Sometimes people anukuntaru modern avvali ante traditions vadileyali ani.Inkonthamandi tradition follow avvali ante modern ideas accept cheyakudadu ani.Kaani naaku rendu extremes correct anipinchavu.

Manam manaki valuable ga anipinche traditions ni continue chestune modern life ni accept cheyachu.For example,manam traditional festival celebrate chestune online work cheyachu.Manam mother tongue lo matladutune English nerchukovachu.Manam traditional food tinesune international food kuda try cheyachu.Traditional clothes special occasions lo vesukuntune modern clothes daily wear cheyachu.

Culture change avvadam normal.Prathi generation tana own lifestyle create cheskuntundi.Mana grandparents generation ki unna life completely different.Mana parents generation kuda different.Mana generation inka different.Raboye generation inka different ga untundi.

Important thing enti ante,change avuthunnappudu mana roots completely marchipokudadu.

Tradition lo manaki useful ga unna values ni preserve cheyali.At the same time,harmful practices unte vatini question cheyali.Everything old kabatti correct ani cheppalem.Everything new kabatti better ani kuda cheppalem.Manam think chesi decide cheyali.

Naaku Indian culture lo most beautiful thing diversity.Different people,different languages,different religions,different food,different festivals,different traditions...anni different aina,anni oka country lo kalisi untayi.

Unity ante andaroo same ga undadam kaadu.Different ga unna people okarinokaru respect cheskuntu kalisi undadam.

Future India modern ga undali,kaani roots ni marchipokudadu.Technology lo munduku vellali,education improve cheyali,people ki equal opportunities ivvali.Alage mana languages,arts,food,festivals and traditions ni kuda preserve cheyali.

Endukante culture anedi museum lo petti chuse old object kaadu.Culture anedi manam daily life lo practice chese thing.Mana food lo undi,mana language lo undi,mana family lo undi,mana festivals lo undi,mana memories lo undi.

Eventually,manam next generation ki em pass chestham anedi important.Mana culture ni exactly same ga pass cheyalsina avasaram ledu.Kaani danilo unna good values,stories,memories and identity ni future ki teesukellali.

Ade tradition mariyu modern life madhya balance.Ade naaku Indian culture yokka real beauty laga anipisthundi.

### **3.# \*\*Financial Matters, Money and Personal Life\*\***

Tradition mariyu modern life balance gurinchi inko example cheppalanukuంటున్నాను.Nenu chusina konni families,weekdays lo completely modern lifestyle follow chేస్తారు,office,gym,online classes,kaani weekend వచ్చినప్పుడు temple వెళ్ళడం,family తో traditional food cheయడం,elders daggara kూర్చొని matladatam continue chేస్తారు.Idi naaku perfect balance లాగా anipisthundi.Manam prathi roju traditional గా undalsina avasaram ledు,prathi roju completely modern గా undalsina avasaram కూడా ledు.Situation batti,occasion batti,manam decide cheసుకోవచ్చు.Alage పిల్లలకి ee balance ni model cheయడం important.Vallu chూస్తారు parents ela live chేస్తున్నారో,అదే follow చేస్తారు.Manam values tо paatు openness kూడా chupiste,vallu కూడా balanced గా grow avutharు.Future India ఎలాంటిదైనా,నేను ఆశిస్తున్నాను ఇదే balance continue అవ్వాలని,roots తో connected గా ఉంటూ future వైపు move అవ్వాలని.

script11.category: Financial Matters, Money and Personal Life
script11.title: Understanding Money
script11.content:
Money gurinchi manam chinnappati nunchi vintune untam.Kaani money actualga ela work chestundo manam chala latega understand chestham.Chinnappudu money ante just konukkodaniki use chese thing anipisthundi.Ippudu age perigina tarvata money anedi mana life lo chala important role play chestundani artham avuthundi.

Food,education,travel,house,rent,bills and entertainment...almost everything ki money avasaram untundi.Anduke money earn cheyadam important.Kaani money earn cheyadam okkate important kaadu.Danini ela use chestham anedi kuda important.

Konni times manaki salary vachina ventane spend cheyali anipisthundi.Kotha clothes,kotha phone,food,shopping or outings kosam money use chestham.Avi wrong kaadu.Manam earn chesina money tho enjoy cheyadam kuda necessary.Kaani motham money spend chesi tarvata emergency vachinappudu problem avuthundi.

Anduke saving important ani slowly artham avuthundi.Monthly income lo konchem amount pakkana pettukunte,unexpected situations vachinappudu help avuthundi.Oka emergency expense vachina appudu vere vallani depend avvalsina situation tagguthundi.

Money gurinchi ఇంకో important thing budgeting.Budget ante manaki entha money vastundi,ekkada entha spend chestunnam ani track cheyadam.First lo konchem boringga anipinchachu.Kaani once habit ayithe,manam unnecessary expenses ekkada chestunnamo easyga telustundi.

Nenu anukuntunnadi money ni fear tho chudakudadu.Alage carelessga kuda chudakudadu.Money is a tool.Manam danini correctga use chesthe life konchem comfortablega untundi.

Finally,money important ayina,money alone happiness guarantee cheyadu.Money valla security and freedom ravachu.Kaani family,time,health and peace kuda equally important.

Money గురించి ఇంకో important point నాకు అనిపిస్తుంది,అది financial literacy.School లో మనకి maths,science బాగా nేర్పిస్తారు,kaani money ela manage cheయాలో,taxes ఎలా pని చేస్తాయో,investments అంటే ఏంటో ఎవరూ సరిగ్గా చెప్పరు.Anduke chala mandi ee things ni college leda job start చేసిన తర్వాత,trial and error ద్వారా nేర్చుకుంటారు.నేను ippudu consciously ee topics గురించి చదవడానికి try చేస్తున్నాను.Basic budgeting,emergency fund,insurance,and simple investments గురించి తెలుసుకోవడం valla future కోసం better ga prepare avvachu.Money గురించి matladatam family లో కూడా open గా ఉండాలి అని నాకు అనిపిస్తుంది.Chala families లో money ఒక taboo topic laga treat chేస్తారు.Kaani పిల్లలకి చిన్నప్పుడే basic financial concepts nerpiste,వాళ్ళు పెద్దయ్యాక better decisions తీసుకోగలరు.Finally,money ni understand చేసుకోవడం అనేది oka lifelong skill,adi manaki security మరియు peace of mind istundi.

script12.category: Financial Matters, Money and Personal Life
script12.title: Saving Money for the Future
script12.content:
Nenu money gurinchi think chesinappudu saving ane word first gurthostundi.Earlier saving ante salary lo migilina money ni pakkana pettadam anukunevadini.Kaani ippudu konchem differentga think chesthunnanu.Saving ante migilina money ni save cheyadam kaadu.First save chesi,remaining money ni spend cheyadam better.

Manam monthly income pondinappudu first expenses gurinchi think chestham.Rent,bills,food,travel,shopping ila chala things untayi.Avi complete ayina tarvata em migilithe adi saving ani anukuntam.Kaani konni months em migaladu.Appudu saving kuda undadu.

Anduke income vachina ventane konchem amount separate cheskovadam useful.Small amount ayina okay.Important thing habit.

Saving ki reason future kosam prepare avvadam.Oka day sudden medical expense ravachu.Job temporaryga lekapovachu.Laptop or phone repair avasaram ravachu.Family lo unexpected expense ravachu.Aa time lo savings help chestayi.

Future ante just emergencies kaadu.Oka trip ki save cheyachu.Oka course kosam save cheyachu.Kotha laptop konadaniki save cheyachu.Oka big goal kosam save cheyachu.

Saving chesthunappudu patience chala important.Quick results expect cheyakudadu.Monthly small amount save chesthe,months and years tarvata adi meaningful amount avuthundi.

Inka important thing unnecessary comparison avoid cheyadam.Friend new phone konnadu ani manam kuda immediatega phone konalsina avasaram ledu.Evaraina expensive restaurant ki vellaru ani manam kuda every weekend spend cheyalsina avasaram ledu.

Mana financial situation manaki telusu.Inkokari life ni chusi mana spending decide cheyakudadu.

Naku anipisthundi,saving ante life ni enjoy cheyakunda money collect cheyadam kaadu.Future gurinchi responsiblega undi,present ni kuda balance cheyadam.

Saving గురించి ఇంకో point cheppalanukuంటున్నాను,అది automation.నేను నేర్చుకున్నది ఏమిటంటే,manual గా save చేయాలని decide చేసుకుంటే,most of the time అది జరగదు,endukante temptation to spend ఎక్కువగా untundi.Anduke salary వచ్చిన వెంటనే oka fixed amount automatic గా separate account కి transfer అయ్యేలా set చేసుకుంటే,manam think cheయకుండానే save అవుతుంది.ఇది oka simple trick,kaani chala effective గా work చేస్తుంది.Alage different goals కోసం separate savings పెట్టుకోవడం కూడా useful.Emergency fund వేరే,travel కోసం వేరే,future purchase కోసం వేరే ఉంటే,clarity ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,saving అనేది oka sacrifice కాదు,it's a form of self-respect.Future లో నాకు నేనే help చేసుకుంటున్నట్టు.Chinna amount ఐనా consistent గా save చేస్తే,years తర్వాత అది oka strong foundation అవుతుంది,and that foundation naaku confidence and freedom istundi.

script13.category: Financial Matters, Money and Personal Life
script13.title: Spending and Lifestyle
script13.content:
Money earn cheyadam oka thing.Money spend cheyadam inko thing.Mana generation lo spending chala easy aipoyindi.Before,shopping kosam store ki vellali.Now phone open chesi few minutes lo anything order cheyachu.

Food delivery apps,online shopping,sales,offers and subscriptions...anni manaki spending easy chestunnayi.Sometimes manaki really need leni things kuda konukkuntam.Just because offer undi ani leda discount undi ani.

Konni times advertisement chusi manaki aa product kavali ani anipisthundi.Adi actual need aa leda just temporary interest aa ani think cheyakunda buy chestham.Tarvata few days use chesi side lo pettestham.

Anduke spending mundu oka simple question ask cheskovali.Do I really need this?

Need and want madhya difference understand cheskunte money management konchem easy avuthundi.Need ante life ki important thing.Want ante manaki kavali anipinche thing.Rendu wrong kaavu.Kaani difference teliste better decisions teesukovachu.

Enjoyment kosam spend cheyadam kuda necessary.Friends tho restaurant ki velladam,travel cheyadam,movie chudatam or favourite food order cheyadam life lo part.But every small happiness kosam money spend cheyalsina avasaram ledu.

Sometimes free things kuda happiness istayi.Friends tho long conversation,evening walk,family tho time spend cheyadam,music vinadam...ivi money lekunda kuda enjoy cheyachu.

Lifestyle increase ayina income kuda increase avvali.Lekapothe manam earn chesina danikante ekkuva spend chestham.

Naku anipisthundi,rich lifestyle kanna controlled lifestyle better.Mana income entha unna,mana spending ni control cheyagaligithe financial stress konchem tagguthundi.

Money ni spend cheyadam tappu kaadu.Money ekkada spend chestunnamo teliyakapovadame problem.

Spending గురించి ఇంకో thing artham ayyindి నాకు,అది intentional spending.Prathi purchase చేసే ముందు,idi naaku actual joy istundа leda temporary excitement matrame ani ఆలోచించడం useful.Chala సార్లు మనం oka product konna తర్వాత,konni రోజులకి ఆ excitement పోతుంది,మళ్ళీ next thing వెతుకుతాము.Ide cycle continue ayithe,manam ఎప్పటికీ satisfied గా undalem.Anduke నేను ఇప్పుడు try చేస్తున్నాను,shopping cheయాలనిపించినప్పుడు konchem wait చేయడానికి.24 hours wait చేస్తే,chala సార్లు ఆ urge తగ్గిపోతుంది.Genuinely avసరం unte,malli alochinchi konukkuntanu.Alage experiences meeda spend చేయడం,things meeda spend చేయడం కంటే ఎక్కువ satisfaction istundi ani chala studies కూడా చెబుతున్నాయి.Travel,oka good meal friends తో,oka new skill nerchukovadam,ivi long-term లో ekkuva happiness istayi కంటే oka kotha gadget.Anduke నేను ఇప్పుడు priorities ni reconsider chేస్తున్నాను.

script14.category: Financial Matters, Money and Personal Life
script14.title: Financial Pressure and Family
script14.content:
Money problems gurinchi open ga matladatam konchem difficult.Endukante financial situation sometimes personal matter laga feel avuthundi.Kaani almost every family lo money gurinchi edo oka type of pressure untundi.

Parents children education kosam money spend chestaru.House expenses untayi,medical expenses untayi,loans undochu,bills untayi.Future kosam savings cheyali.Anni manage cheyadam easy kaadu.

Chinnappudu parents money gurinchi discuss chesthe manaki completega artham kaadu.Age perigina tarvata vallaki unna responsibilities konchem understand avuthayi.

Sometimes family lo money takkuva unna kuda parents children ki best ivvadaniki try chestaru.Valla own needs postpone chesi children kosam spend chestaru.Adi chala big sacrifice.

Anduke financial independence important ani naaku anipisthundi.Money kosam family members meeda completely depend avvakunda,slowly manam mana expenses manage cheskogalige stage ki ravali.

Financial independence ante huge salary ravali ani kaadu.First mana basic expenses ni manage cheyagalagadam,konchem save cheyagalagadam,unexpected expenses ni handle cheyagalagadam.

Alage money valla family relationships damage avvakudadu.Sometimes money matters misunderstandings create chestayi.Who should pay?Who should save?Who should spend?Ila small things arguments ki reason avvachu.

Anduke family lo money gurinchi honest communication important.

Money is important,but relationships kante important kaadu.

Naaku anipisthundi financial stability ante just bank account lo large amount undadam kaadu.Mana money situation gurinchi manaki clarity undadam,mana expenses control lo undadam,mana future gurinchi konchem confidence undadam.

Adhe real financial peace.

Financial pressure గురించి inko point cheppalanukuంటున్నాను,అది generational thinking.Mana parents generation lో job security ki chala importance undedి.Government job,stable salary,pension ivanni priority గా undేవి.Kaani ippudు job market completely different,startups,freelancing,gig economy ivanni common ayipoyాయి.Ee difference valla sometimes parents mariyు children madhya financial decisions గురించి different opinions వస్తాయి.Parents risk తీసుకోవద్దు అంటారు,manam kotha opportunities try cheయాలని అనుకుంటాము.Rendu perspectives కి own logic undi.Anduke ee conversations ని open గా,respect తో handle చేయడం important.నేను నేర్చుకున్నది ఏమిటంటే,parents fear ni అర్థం చేసుకోవడం,vallu naa security గురించి worry padataru కాబట్టి.Alage naa own confidence and research ని కూడా వాళ్ళకి explain చేయడం important.Finally,financial decisions family లో collaborative గా తీసుకుంటే,pressure తగ్గి,better understanding వస్తుంది.

script15.category: Financial Matters, Money and Personal Life
script15.title: Money, Success and a Balanced Life
script15.content:
Money and success ni manam chala times same thing laga chustham.High salary ante successful person ani assume chestham.Expensive car undi ante successful ani anukuntam.Big house undi ante life perfect ani think chestham.

Kaani actually success ki one definition undadu.

Oka person ki high salary important avvachu.Inkokariki peaceful job important avvachu.Marikokariki own business important avvachu.Inkoka person ki family tho ekkuva time spend cheyadam success avvachu.

Money definitely important.Money lekunda chala basic things difficult avuthayi.Education,health,housing and daily needs kosam money avasaram.Anduke money earn cheyadaniki hard work cheyali.

Kaani money kosam entire life sacrifice cheyadam kuda correct kaadu.Oka person huge salary earn chesthu untadu,kani family tho time spend cheyalekapothe,always stress lo unte,life enjoy cheyalekapothe,adi complete success ani cheppalem.

Balance important.

Money earn cheyali.Save cheyali.Future plan cheyali.Kaani present ni kuda live cheyali.

Naku personally financial success ante oka stage lo,na money decisions meeda control undadam.I don't want to spend just because others are spending.I don't want to buy something just to impress people.I want to spend on things that actually matter to me.

Alage future kosam save cheyali.Emergency kosam money undali.Family ki help cheyagalige position lo undali.Mana dreams kosam kuda money use cheyagalagali.

Money manaki freedom ivvali,pressure kaadu.

Eventually,life lo money oka part maatrame.Mana health,family,friends,peace,time and happiness kuda important.

Anduke financial matters ni seriousga teesukovali,but money ni life motham ani think cheyakudadu.

Earn wisely,spend carefully,save regularly,and live peacefully.

Ade naaku balanced financial life ante.

### **4.# \*\*Patriotism, India and What Our Country Means to Us\*\***

Money మరియు success గురించి ఇంకో point నాకు clear గా అనిపిస్తుంది,అది gratitude.మనం ఎప్పుడూ next goal వైపు చూస్తూ ఉంటే,ప్రస్తుతం ఉన్నదాన్ని enjoy చేయలేము.నేను ఇప్పుడు consciously try చేస్తున్నాను,నా current situation ని appreciate చేయడానికి,అదే సమయంలో future కోసం కూడా plan చేస్తూ.Comparison,ముఖ్యంగా social media లో ఇతరుల lifestyle చూసి,మన సొంత progress ని తక్కువగా అంచనా వేయడం easy.Kaani prathi vyakti journey different,starting point different.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,real wealth అంటే kevalam bank balance కాదు,మనకి కావలసినది manam కోరుకున్నప్పుడు cheయగలగడం,మన time meeda control ఉండడం,and మన priorities batti live cheయగలగడం.Money ఈ freedom ఇవ్వడానికి oka tool.Anduke నేను money ని fear చేయకుండా,కానీ దానికి బానిస కూడా కాకుండా,balanced గా చూడాలని try చేస్తున్నాను.

script16.category: Patriotism, India and What Our Country Means to Us
script16.title: What Patriotism Means to Me
script16.content:
Patriotism ante naaku first gurthochedi country kosam love ani.Kaani age perigina tarvata patriotism ante just flag chusi proud feel avvadam leda national anthem vachinappudu emotional avvadam maatrame kaadu ani artham ayyindi.

Mana country ni love cheyadam ante mana country lo unna people ni kuda care cheyadam.Mana surroundings clean ga unchadam,rules follow cheyadam,tax pay cheyadam,public places ni damage cheyakapovadam,others ni respect cheyadam...ivi kuda patriotism lo part.

Chala times patriotism ante army gurinchi maatladatam leda country kosam sacrifice chesina people ni gurthu cheskovadam ani anukuntam.Adi definitely important.But every citizen daily life lo chese small actions kuda country meeda impact chestayi.

Oka person traffic rules follow chesthe,oka person public place lo garbage throw cheyakapothe,oka student sincerega study chesthe,oka employee honestga work chesthe,oka citizen vote chesthe...ivi small things laga kanipinchina country development ki help chestayi.

Mana country perfect kaadu.Mana daggara problems unnayi.Poverty undi,pollution undi,unemployment undi,education and healthcare lo kuda challenges unnayi.Patriotism ante ee problems anni ignore chesi India perfect ani cheppadam kaadu.Problems unnayani accept chesi,vatini improve cheyadaniki try cheyadam kuda patriotism.

Manaki country meeda love unte,manam country better avvali ani korukuntam.Anduke problems gurinchi matladatam wrong kaadu.But criticism tho paatu responsibility kuda undali.

Naku anipisthundi patriotism oka feeling tho start avvachu.Kaani action tho prove avvali.

Mana country kosam prathi person huge sacrifice cheyalsina avasaram ledu.Mana daily life lo manam responsible citizens ga behave chesthe,chala difference create cheyachu.

At the end,patriotism ante just I love my country ani cheppadam kaadu.Mana actions tho aa love ni chupinchadam.

Patriotism గురించి ఇంకో point నాకు important గా అనిపిస్తుంది,అది voting.చాలా మంది young people election వచ్చినప్పుడు casual గా తీసుకుంటారు,vote cheయకపోయినా parledu అనుకుంటారు.Kaani democracy లో ప్రతి vote విలువైనది.Manam ఎవరిని select చేస్తే,వాళ్ళే మన cities,states,and country future ని decide చేస్తారు.Anduke vote cheయడం అనేది oka simple right కాదు,oka responsibility.Alage manam local issues గురించి కూడా aware గా ఉండాలి.Roads,water,electricity,waste management ivanni national politics అంత glamorous గా అనిపించకపోవచ్చు,kaani ivi daily life ని direct గా affect చేస్తాయి.Local governance లో participate cheయడం,complaints raise cheయడం,community meetings కి వెళ్ళడం,ivi కూడా patriotism లో part.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,real patriotism అంటే country గురించి గొప్పగా మాట్లాడడం కాదు,daily గా active citizen గా undadam.

script17.category: Patriotism, India and What Our Country Means to Us
script17.title: Patriotism Beyond Borders
script17.content:
Mana country gurinchi proud feel avvadam natural.India ki chala long history undi.Rich culture undi,different languages unnayi,beautiful traditions unnayi,many achievements unnayi.Kaani patriotism ante mana country ni vere countries tho compare chesi,mana country always best ani prove cheyadam ani nenu anukonu.

Every country ki strengths untayi,weaknesses kuda untayi.Manaki nachina things mana country lo untayi.Alage improve cheyalsina things kuda untayi.

Sometimes social media lo country comparison chustham.Oka country technology lo ahead undi ani,inkoka country education lo better ani discussions jaruguthayi.Appudu patriotic ga feel ayyi,manam mana country ni defend cheyadaniki try chestham.Adi understandable.Kaani healthy patriotism ante facts ni accept cheyadam kuda.

Mana country lo problems unte vatini accept chesi,better ga ela cheyali ani think cheyali.Oka person problem point out chesthe,athanu country ni hate chestunnadu ani immediately decide cheyakudadu.Sometimes criticism kuda improvement kosame untundi.

Naku patriotism ante emotional attachment tho paatu responsibility kuda.

India lo different religions,different languages,different communities unnayi.Okariki inkokari culture different ga undochu.Kaani country meeda shared identity manalni connect chestundi.

Anduke patriotism ante only one group ni support cheyadam kaadu.Every citizen ni equal ga respect cheyadam kuda.

Mana country strong ga undali ante people madhya respect undali.People safe ga feel avvali.Young people ki opportunities undali.Education better avvali.Healthcare accessible ga undali.

Ivi anni improve ayithe,adi country development.

Naaku anipisthundi true patriotism ante mana country ni blindly praise cheyadam kaadu.Mana country better future kosam honest ga care cheyadam.

Patriotism beyond borders గురించి ఇంకో point cheppalanukuంటున్నాను.Ippudు chala young Indians వేరే countries లో study చేస్తున్నారు,work చేస్తున్నారు.Vallu కూడా equally patriotic గా ఉండగలరు,physically country లో లేకపోయినా.Vallu abroad లో India ని represent చేస్తారు,mana culture,values ni carry చేస్తారు.Alage vallu earn చేసిన knowledge,skills,connections future లో India కి కూడా contribute చేయవచ్చు.Anduke patriotism ni physical presence తో measure cheయడం సరైనది కాదు.Chala NRIs India development లో investments చేస్తారు,charity చేస్తారు,skills teach చేస్తారు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,globalized world లో patriotism అంటే మన country ని రక్షించుకోవడం matrame కాదు,మన country ni positive గా represent చేయడం,ఎక్కడ ఉన్నా దాని గురించి గర్వంగా,బాధ్యతగా ఉండడం.దేశం మనలో ఉంటుంది,మనం దేశంలో ఉన్నా లేకపోయినా.

script18.category: Patriotism, India and What Our Country Means to Us
script18.title: Remembering Those Who Served the Country
script18.content:
Mana country gurinchi matladetappudu,India kosam service chesina people ni gurthu cheskokunda undalem.Among them,armed forces lo work chese soldiers gurinchi especially respect tho matladali.

Mana daily life lo manam peaceful ga study chestham,work chestham,family tho time spend chestham.Vallaki మాత్రం duty chala different ga untundi.Vallu chala situations lo family ki dooranga undalsi vastundi.Special occasions miss avvachu.Birthdays,festivals,family functions anni miss ayye chances untayi.

Oka soldier duty lo unnapudu,valla family kuda oka different type of responsibility carry chestundi.Vallu kuda worry tho untaru.Wait chestaru.Anduke service ane word venuka chala sacrifice untundi.

Kaani patriotism ni only soldiers tho connect cheyadam kuda complete picture kaadu.Soldiers country ni protect chestaru.Ade time lo teachers future generation ni build chestaru.Doctors people ni treat chestaru.Farmers food produce chestaru.Scientists new things create chestaru.Workers cities and systems run cheyadaniki contribute chestaru.

Prathi profession country ki different way lo help chestundi.

Anduke country service ante only uniform vesukuni border lo duty cheyadam maatrame kaadu.Mana work ni honesty tho cheyadam kuda service.

Oka teacher sincerega teach chesthe,oka doctor patient ni care tho treat chesthe,oka farmer hard work chesthe,oka student sincerega prepare ayithe,oka employee honestga work chesthe...prathi action country ni indirectly strengthen chestundi.

Mana freedom mariyu opportunities venuka chala generations effort undi.Aa history ni remember cheyadam important.

Kaani past ni only celebrate cheyakunda,present lo mana responsibility ni kuda remember cheyali.

Country kosam sacrifice chesina vallani respect cheyadam oka part.Ade country ni better ga build cheyadam another part.

Naku patriotism ante past sacrifices ni gurthu cheskoni,present responsibility ni accept chesi,future generation kosam better country create cheyadaniki try cheyadam.

Country service గురించి ఇంకో point,నాకు anipisthundి memorials and history teaching గురించి.School లో freedom fighters,soldiers గురించి teach చేసేటప్పుడు,వాటిని కేవలం exam కోసం చదవడం కాదు,ఆ sacrifices venuka unna real meaning ni artham chేసుకోవాలి.Chala young people కి ee history గురించి deep knowledge లేదు,వాళ్ళు కేవలం dates and names గుర్తు పెట్టుకుంటారు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,schools మరియు families ee stories ni ఎక్కువ engaging గా,relatable గా చెప్పాలి.Documentaries,museums,war memorials కి visits ivanni help చేస్తాయి.Alage ప్రస్తుత soldiers and their families కి కూడా support చూపించడం important,కేవలం martyrs ని remember చేయడం కాదు.Veterans కి jobs,healthcare,and respect ivvడం కూడా country responsibility.Naaku ఇప్పుడు అనిపిస్తుంది,history ని గుర్తు పెట్టుకోవడం inspiration కోసం,guilt కోసం కాదు.అది future generations ni better citizens గా చేయాలి.

script19.category: Patriotism, India and What Our Country Means to Us
script19.title: Patriotism Through Young People
script19.content:
Young generation country future ani manam chala times vintam.Kaani aa statement actualga chala meaning kaligi untundi.Endukante future lo country ela untundo,ippudu young people em nerchukuntunnaro,ela behave chestunnaro,ela think chestunnaro vatipai depend avuthundi.

Students ki patriotism ante national days roju flags pattukovadam maatrame kaadu.Students sincerega education meeda focus cheyadam,skills develop cheskovadam,responsible ga behave cheyadam kuda country ki contribution.

Manam future lo doctors,engineers,teachers,scientists,business people,artists and many other professions lo untam.Mana work quality country development meeda impact chestundi.

For example,oka engineer honestga useful product create chesthe,oka scientist new solution develop chesthe,oka teacher students ni betterga guide chesthe,oka entrepreneur jobs create chesthe...ivi anni country ki contributions.

Young people ki technology advantage undi.Mana generation information ni very easily access cheyagaladu.World lo em jaruguthundo immediately telusukovachu.Ideas share cheyachu,skills learn cheyachu,people tho connect avvachu.

Kaani technology tho responsibility kuda undali.Fake news ni blindly share cheyakudadu.Hate spread cheyakudadu.Okarini vallaki different opinion undani insult cheyakudadu.

Patriotism ante mana country citizens andarini respect cheyadam kuda.

Mana generation India ni next level ki teesukellali ante education,innovation and responsible thinking important.

Country kosam huge speech ivvadam kanna,roju oka useful thing cheyadam sometimes more valuable.

Oka student sincerega study cheyadam small thing laga anipinchachu.Kaani years tarvata aa student oka good professional ayithe,country ki contribute chestadu.

Anduke young generation ki patriotism ante future gurinchi responsibility teesukovadam.

Mana country future automatic ga better avvadu.Manam better citizens ayithe better future create avuthundi.

Young people patriotism గురించి ఇంకో thing cheppalanukuంటున్నాను,social entrepreneurship గురించి.Ippudు chala young Indians సొంతంగా startups,NGOs start చేస్తున్నారు,వాళ్ళు local problems ni solve చేయడానికి try చేస్తున్నారు.Rural education,healthcare access,clean water,women empowerment ఇలా different areas లో young people innovative solutions తీసుకువస్తున్నారు.Idi నాకు inspiring గా అనిపిస్తుంది.Alage young people social media ni positive change కోసం కూడా use చేస్తున్నారు,awareness create చేయడానికి,fundraising కోసం,మరియు accountability ని demand చేయడానికి.Technology వల్ల ఒక్క person కూడా large impact create చేయగలడు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,patriotism ippudు కేవలం government job చేయడం లేదా army లో join అవ్వడం matrame కాదు.Prathi field లో innovative గా,responsible గా contribute చేయడం కూడా country కి service.Young generation ee energy ni continue చేస్తే,India future definitely brighter గా untundi.

script20.category: Patriotism, India and What Our Country Means to Us
script20.title: A Better India for the Future
script20.content:
Patriotism gurinchi chala different opinions untayi.Konthamandiki patriotism ante national symbols gurinchi respect.Konthamandiki army and sacrifices gurinchi gurthu cheskovadam.Konthamandiki country development kosam work cheyadam.Naku ivanni patriotism lo parts laga anipisthayi.

Kaani future India gurinchi think chesthe,naaku oka question vastundi.Manam next generation ki elaanti country leave cheyali?

Clean cities undali.Safe roads undali.Better schools undali.Good healthcare undali.More jobs undali.People ki equal opportunities undali.Environment ni protect cheyali.

Ivi government okkate cheyalsina responsibilities kaavu.Citizens kuda participate cheyali.

Manam garbage ekkada padithe akkada throw cheyakunda start cheyachu.Traffic rules follow cheyachu.Public property ni damage cheyakunda care cheyachu.Others rights ni respect cheyachu.Honestga work cheyachu.

Ivi very small things laga anipinchachu.Kaani millions of people same thing follow chesthe huge change vastundi.

Patriotism ante country ni love cheyadam.Aa love ni action ga convert cheyadam inka important.

Mana country lo chala diversity undi.Mana language different kavachu,religion different kavachu,food different kavachu,tradition different kavachu.Kaani manam andarum oka shared country lo live chestunnam.

Anduke differences valla hate create cheyakunda,respect create cheyali.

Naaku India future gurinchi hope undi.Young people ki talent undi.Technology undi.New ideas unnayi.Opportunities kuda slowly increase avuthunnayi.

Kaani development ante only bigger buildings,new technology and more money kaadu.People happyga,safega,respect tho live cheyagalagadam kuda development.

At the end,patriotism ante flag ni respect cheyadam,anthem ni respect cheyadam,history ni remember cheyadam important.Aithe vatitho paatu mana daily responsibilities ni kuda respect cheyali.

Manam perfect citizens avvalsina avasaram ledu.Kaani responsible citizens avvadaniki try cheyali.

Maybe ade simple ga cheppalante,patriotism ante India nunchi em pondam ani maatrame kaadu,India kosam manam em contribute cheyagalamo kuda alochinchadam.

Adhe naaku real patriotism.

### **5.# \*\*Scams, Fraud and Staying Safe in Everyday Life\*\***

A better India గురించి ఇంకో point,నాకు environment గురించి కూడా cheppalanipిస్తుంది.Development అంటే కేవలం buildings,roads,technology కాదు.Clean air,clean water,and healthy environment కూడా development లో essential part.Ippudు chala cities pollution తో struggle avutunnayi.Manam individual గా trees నాటడం,water waste cheయకపోవడం,public transport use చేయడం,plastic తగ్గించడం ఇలాంటి చిన్న steps తీసుకోవచ్చు.Alage government policies కూడా environment ni priority గా treat చేయాలి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,future generations కి manam ఎలాంటి India ivvalanుకుంటున్నామో ఆలోచించినప్పుడు,కేవలం economic growth కాదు,sustainable growth గురించి కూడా ఆలోచించాలి.Better India అంటే prathi citizen safe గా,healthy గా,and hopeful గా feel అయ్యే country.Ade real patriotism,కేవలం present గురించి కాదు,future గురించి కూడా responsible గా ఆలోచించడం.

script21.category: Scams, Fraud and Staying Safe in Everyday Life
script21.title: Understanding Everyday Scams
script21.content:
Scams gurinchi manam news lo chala sarlu vintam.Kaani scam ante just big financial fraud ani chala mandi anukuntaru.Actually mana daily life lo kuda small scams chala common ga jaruguthayi.

Oka unknown person call chesi,mee bank account close avvabothundi ani cheppachu.Oka message lo,you won a prize ani ravachu.Inko message lo,parcel delivery kosam payment cheyali ani cheppachu.Sometimes job offer peru tho kuda money adugutharu.

Scammers main ga mana fear leda excitement ni use chestaru.Mana bank account problem ani chepthe manam panic avvachu.Oka big prize vachindi ani chepthe manam excited avvachu.Job opportunity ani chepthe immediate ga namme chance untundi.

Scam lo common thing enti ante,they want us to act quickly.Time ivvakunda immediate decision teesukomantaru.Oka link open cheyamantaru,OTP cheppamantaru,bank details ivvamantaru leda money transfer cheyamantaru.

Anduke evaraina urgent ga money leda personal information adigithe,first calm ga undali.

Bank nunchi call vachina,official number ki maname call chesi confirm cheyachu.Unknown links open cheyakunda undali.OTP ni evarithonaina share cheyakudadu.Passwords and important details kuda private ga unchali.

Sometimes scam very professional ga kanipisthundi.Logo undachu,proper language use cheyachu,official person laga matladachu.Kaani manam verify cheyakunda trust cheyakudadu.

Naaku anipisthundi scam nunchi protect avvadam ki biggest weapon technology kaadu.Common sense and patience.

Oka message genuine aa kaada ani doubt vaste,immediate action teesukokunda first verify cheyadam better.

Scammers mana money ni target chestaru.Kaani mana attention and emotions ni first target chestaru.Anduke calm ga think cheyadam chala important.

Scams గురించి ఇంకో important point,social media మీద ఉండే fake profiles గురించి.Ippudు scammers fake profiles create చేసి,friendship or relationship మొదలుపెట్టి,slowly trust build చేసి,తర్వాత money adugutaru.Ee type scams especially emotional గా vulnerable ఉన్న people ni target చేస్తాయి.Anduke online లో కొత్తగా పరిచయమైన వ్యక్తి,ఎంత genuine గా అనిపించినా,money విషయంలో అప్రమత్తంగా ఉండాలి.Alage fake job postings,fake lottery messages,and fake government scheme messages కూడా common గా వస్తున్నాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ఈ digital world లో awareness ఒక్కటే మనలni protect చేయగలదు.Family members తో,ముఖ్యంగా పెద్దవాళ్ళు మరియు పిల్లలతో,ఈ scams గురించి regular గా matladatam useful.Oka scam గురించి తెలిస్తే,దాన్ని ఇతరులతో share చేయడం కూడా important,ఎందుకంటే ఒక్కరి experience చాలా మందిని save చేయగలదు.

script22.category: Scams, Fraud and Staying Safe in Everyday Life
script22.title: Online Shopping Scams
script22.content:
Online shopping mana life ni chala easy chesindi.Phone lo few minutes lo clothes,food,electronics and almost anything order cheyachu.Kaani convenience tho paatu scams kuda increase ayyayi.

Sometimes social media lo very attractive offer kanipisthundi.Oka expensive product very low price ki available ani cheptaru.We see the discount and immediately interested avutham.

Website genuine laga kanipinchachu.Product photos professional ga untayi.Reviews kuda undochu.Kaani payment chesina tarvata product raakapovachu.Sometimes completely different product ravachu.Inkonni cases lo website itself fake ayyi undachu.

Another common problem fake customer care numbers.Unknown websites lo customer care number search chesi call chesthe,scammer help chesthunna laga act cheyachu.

Anduke online shopping lo konchem careful ga undali.

Very low price kanipisthe first question adugovali.Is this offer realistic?Normal price tho compare cheyali.Website details check cheyali.Return policy unda?Contact information proper ga unda?Reviews genuine ga kanipisthunnaya?

Payment chesthunappudu kuda careful ga undali.Unknown person ki direct money transfer cheyakunda,reliable payment methods use cheyadam better.

Sometimes scammer refund kosam call chestadu.Refund process ani cheppi OTP adagachu leda screen sharing app install cheyamantadu.Ilaanti situations lo extra careful ga undali.

Online shopping itself dangerous kaadu.Careless shopping dangerous.

Manam physical shop ki vellinappudu product chusi konukuntam.Online lo screen meeda chustham kabatti konchem extra verification avasaram.

Naaku anipisthundi,discount kosam hurry avvakudadu.Oka deal miss ayina parledhu.Money lose avvadam kanna deal miss avvadam better.

Online shopping scams గురించి ఇంకో point,fake delivery messages గురించి.Ippudు oka common scam enti ante,"your parcel is stuck,pay this fee to release it" అని message వస్తుంది.Manam order చేయకపోయినా,confusion valla click చేసే chance ఉంటుంది.Anduke ఎప్పుడూ order status ని official app leda website లోనే check చేయాలి,message లో ఉన్న link meeda click చేయకూడదు.Alage fake reviews గురించి కూడా జాగ్రత్తగా ఉండాలి.Chala fake websites బాగా written reviews పెడతాయి,confidence create చేయడానికి.Product ni multiple sources లో verify చేయడం better.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,trusted platforms లోనే shopping చేయడం,and unknown websites లో very cheap deals చూసినప్పుడు extra careful గా ఉండడం safest approach.ఒక్క click valla financial and personal information రెండూ risk లో padavachu,anduke patience ఎప్పుడూ shortcut కంటే better.

script23.category: Scams, Fraud and Staying Safe in Everyday Life
script23.title: Job and Investment Scams
script23.content:
Job kosam search chesthunna people ni kuda scammers target chestaru.Ee type scams chala dangerous ga untayi.Endukante job kavali ane desperation ni use chestaru.

Oka person call chesi,mee profile select ayyindi ani cheppachu.Big company lo job offer ani cheppachu.Salary kuda attractive ga cheppachu.Appudu manam excited avutham.

Kaani tarvata registration fee,training fee,document fee leda security deposit ani money adugutharu.Job confirm avvadaniki mundu payment cheyali ani cheptaru.

Oka genuine opportunity ki verification process undochu.Kaani money pay cheyakapothe job raadani pressure create chesthe,doubt ravali.

Investment scams kuda similar ga untayi.Easy money,quick returns,guaranteed profit ani cheptaru.For example,small amount invest chesthe few days lo double avuthundi ani promise chestaru.

Money earn cheyadam easy ani cheppe offers ni carefully examine cheyali.Real investments lo risk untundi.Guaranteed high returns ani cheppadam red flag avvachu.

Scammers sometimes WhatsApp groups create chestaru.Daily profit screenshots share chestaru.Other people successful ayinattu show chestaru.Danitho trust create chestaru.

First small amount invest chesi profit kuda chupinchavachu.Appudu manam bigger amount invest chestham.Finally money withdraw cheyalem.

Anduke job aina investment aina,first verify cheyali.Company official website check cheyali.Official contact details use cheyali.Unknown person cheppina information meeda only depend avvakudadu.

Desperation and greed rendu scams lo dangerous emotions.

Job kavali ani hurry lo wrong person ni trust cheyakudadu.Quick money kavali ani unrealistic promises ni believe cheyakudadu.

Slow and genuine opportunity better than quick and risky money.

Job and investment scams గురించి ఇంకో point,cryptocurrency and trading scams గురించి.Ippudు social media లో chala fake trading gurus కనిపిస్తారు,వాళ్ళు guaranteed profits promise చేస్తారు.Screenshots,testimonials,fake success stories వాళ్ళు use చేసి trust create చేస్తారు.Kaani real trading మరియు investing లో risk ఎప్పుడూ untundi,guaranteed returns అనేది red flag.Alage part-time job offers,"work from home,earn lakhs" లాంటి messages కూడా చాలా common గా మారాయి.Ee jobs లో మొదట simple tasks ఇచ్చి,చిన్న payment కూడా చేస్తారు,తర్వాత పెద్ద amount invest చేయమని అడుగుతారు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ఏదైనా opportunity చాలా easy గా,చాలా fast గా money ఇస్తుంది అని అనిపిస్తే,అది వెంటనే question చేయాలి.Real income కి time,effort,and skill avసరం.Shortcut promises చేసేవి usually scams గా ఉంటాయి.

script24.category: Scams, Fraud and Staying Safe in Everyday Life
script24.title: Family and Elderly People Being Targeted
script24.content:
Scams gurinchi matladetappudu elderly people gurinchi special ga mention cheyali.Endukante technology fast ga change avuthundi.Konthamandi older people ki new apps,online banking and digital payments meeda complete confidence undakapovachu.

Scammers idi advantage ga use chestaru.

Oka person bank employee laga call chesi,your account has a problem ani cheppachu.Oka government officer laga matladi,documents update cheyali ani cheppachu.Oka relative laga act chesi,emergency undi money kavali ani message cheyachu.

Sometimes scammer voice kuda familiar laga anipinchadaniki information use chestadu.

Elderly people alone ga unnappudu immediate decision teesukune chance ekkuva.Anduke family members vallaki basic online safety gurinchi explain cheyali.

Important thing enti ante,scam ayina person ni blame cheyakudadu.Scam jarigina tarvata already stress lo untaru.Blame chesthe future lo problem vachina family ki cheppakunda hide chese chance untundi.

Instead,calm ga listen cheyali and situation ni understand cheskovali.

Family lo simple rules create cheskovachu.Unknown callers ki bank details,OTP,passwords share cheyakudadu.Large payment before confirming with family cheyakudadu.Unknown links open cheyakudadu.

Children and younger family members technology lo comfortable ga untaru.Parents and grandparents ki support cheyadam useful.

Scammers age or education chusi always target cheyaru.Emotion chusi target chestaru.

Fear,trust,urgency and confusion...ivi vallaki useful.

Anduke family lo financial and online safety gurinchi open ga matladukovali.

Oka scam jaragakunda prevent cheyadam best.Kaani mistake jarigina kuda shame feel avvakunda immediately trusted person ki cheppadam even more important.

Elderly people scams గురించి ఇంకో point,fake tech support calls గురించి.Scammers "your computer has a virus" అని call చేసి,remote access apps install చేయమని చెప్తారు.Ee విధంగా వాళ్ళు device ని control చేసి,bank details దొంగిలిస్తారు.Elderly people కి technology గురించి full అవగాహన లేకపోతే,ఈ calls నిజమైనవి అని నమ్మే chance ఎక్కువ.Anduke family members regular గా parents,grandparents తో ee scams గురించి simple language లో matladali,examples తో explain చేయాలి.Alage emergency గా డబ్బు కావాలని,family member ఆపదలో ఉన్నారని fake calls కూడా వస్తాయి.Ee situations లో panic avvakunda,family group లో వెంటనే verify చేయడం best.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ఒక safe word or code family లో పెట్టుకోవడం కూడా useful,genuine emergency ని fake call నుండి వేరు చేయడానికి.Awareness మరియు open communication ఈ scams నుండి family ni best గా protect చేస్తాయి.

script25.category: Scams, Fraud and Staying Safe in Everyday Life
script25.title: How to Stay Safe From Scams
script25.content:
Scams completely disappear avvavu.Mana technology change ayina koddi scammers kuda new methods create chestaru.Anduke every scam ni individually remember cheyadam kanna,basic habits develop cheskovadam better.

First,urgent calls ni blindly trust cheyakudadu.Evaraina immediate ga action teesukomante,first pause cheyali.

Second,OTP,password,PIN,bank details and other sensitive information evarithonaina share cheyakudadu.Official person ani cheppina kuda independently verify cheyali.

Third,unknown links meeda click cheyakunda undali.Message genuine laga kanipinchina,link open cheyadaniki mundu sender ni verify cheyali.

Fourth,too-good-to-be-true offers ni question cheyali.Big prize,guaranteed profit,easy job or huge discount ani cheppinappudu excitement tho immediate decision teesukokudadu.

Fifth,online lo evaraina money adigithe,especially new contact ayithe,first identity confirm cheyali.

Sixth,important accounts ki strong passwords use cheyali and possible ayithe extra security options enable cheyali.

Inka important thing awareness.Mana family members ki kuda scams gurinchi cheppali.Elderly people,children and people who are not comfortable with technology ki basic safety explain cheyali.

Scam jarigina situation lo silent ga undakudadu.Immediately bank or concerned service ni contact chesi,available official complaint process use cheyali.

Most importantly,scammed person ni blame cheyakudadu.Scammer goal manalni confuse cheyadam and emotions use cheyadam.Manam careful ga unna kuda sophisticated scam lo trap ayye chance undi.

Anduke smart person ante every call ni doubt chese person kaadu.Every important request ni verify chese person.

Money lose avvakunda undadam important.Kaani personal information and trust protect cheyadam kuda equally important.

Simple ga cheppalante,\*\*pause,think,verify,then act.\*\*

Aa one habit chala scams nunchi manalni protect cheyagaladu.

### **6.# \*\*Fashion, Personal Style and Changing Trends\*\***

Scam awareness గురించి ఇంకో final point,digital hygiene గురించి.Manam మన phones and accounts ని ఎలా maintain చేస్తామో,అది కూడా safety లో part.Regular గా passwords change చేయడం,unknown apps install చేయకపోవడం,and app permissions check చేయడం useful habits.Alage public WiFi meeda sensitive transactions చేయకుండా ఉండడం better,endukante అవి easily hackable.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,scams ni completely avoid చేయడం possible కాకపోవచ్చు,kaani awareness valla risk చాలా వరకు తగ్గించవచ్చు.Prathi family,prathi generation ee basic digital safety habits nerchukovali.Schools లో కూడా ee topics teach చేస్తే బాగుంటుంది,ఎందుకంటే ఈ digital world లో పిల్లలు కూడా early age నుండే online ఉంటున్నారు.Finally,scams గురించి matladatam embarrassing విషయం కాదు.Open గా matladi,ఒకరి experience నుండి అందరూ నేర్చుకుంటే,మొత్తం community safer గా అవుతుంది.

script26.category: Fashion, Personal Style and Changing Trends
script26.title: What Fashion Means to Me
script26.content:
Fashion ante naaku just expensive clothes leda latest trends ani anipinchadu.Fashion ante manam comfortablega feel ayye way lo manalni manam express cheskovadam.

Chinnappudu parents em clothes koni istharo ave wear chestham.Appudu matching colors enti,trend enti ani ekkuva think cheyam.Kaani age perigina tarvata manaki own choices develop avuthayi.Ee color naaku suit avuthundi,ee style comfortablega untundi ani maname decide cheskuntam.

Social media valla fashion trends chala fastga change avuthunnayi.Today oka style popular ga untundi.Repu inkoka style trend avuthundi.Celebrities or influencers oka particular outfit wear chesthe,immediately chala mandi danini follow cheyadaniki try chestaru.

Kaani every trend andariki suit avvadu.Oka person ki bagunna outfit inko person ki comfortablega lekapovachu.Anduke trend follow cheyadam kanna,manaki suit ayye style identify cheskovadam better.

Fashion lo comfort kuda important.Eentha stylish dress ayina,wear chesinappudu uncomfortablega feel aithe manam confidentga undalem.

Alage fashion kosam unnecessary money spend cheyakudadu.Kotha trend vachina pratisari kotha clothes konalsina avasaram ledu.Mana wardrobe lo unna clothes ni different ways lo combine cheskunte kuda new looks create cheyachu.

Naaku fashion ante confidence tho kuda connected anipisthundi.Mana clothes perfectga undali ani kaadu.Manam vesukunna clothes lo comfortablega feel avvali.

Eventually fashion is personal.Prathi person ki own style untundi.Some people traditional clothes prefer chestaru.Some people western style prefer chestaru.Some people simple outfits prefer chestaru.Inkonthamandi colorful and creative styles like chestaru.

Correct fashion ante everyone follow chese style kaadu.Manaki comfortablega,confidentga anipinche style.

Fashion గురించి ఇంకో point,నాకు anipisthundi seasonal మరియు climate appropriate dressing గురించి.Chala సార్లు మనం trend follow చేయడానికి,weather కి suit అవ్వని clothes ఎంచుకుంటాము.Kaani real style అంటే situation కి,weather కి,and occasion కి సరిపోయే విధంగా dress చేసుకోవడం కూడా.Summer లో heavy fabrics,winter లో thin clothes ఎంచుకుంటే,uncomfortable గా untundi,confidence కూడా తగ్గుతుంది.Alage occasion ki appropriate గా dress చేయడం కూడా ఒక skill.Office కి,casual outing కి,festival కి,ప్రతిదానికి different approach అవసరం.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,fashion sense అంటే expensive brands తెలియడం కాదు,situation ni అర్థం చేసుకుని,దానికి తగినట్టు dress చేసుకోవడం.Ee skill practice తో develop అవుతుంది.Mistakes చేయడం,different styles try చేయడం,slowly మనకి ఏది suit అవుతుందో నేర్చుకోవడం,ఇదే fashion journey.

script27.category: Fashion, Personal Style and Changing Trends
script27.title: Social Media and Fashion Trends
script27.content:
Ippudu fashion trends change avvadam chala fastga jaruguthundi.Daniki main reason social media.Instagram,YouTube and other platforms valla world lo ekkada trend ayina style manaki few minutes lo telisipothundi.

Oka celebrity new outfit wear chesthe,adi viral avvachu.Oka influencer oka particular style chupisthe,thousands of people same style try cheyachu.

Social media fashion ni accessible chesindi.Antha varaku manam magazines leda television lo fashion chusevallam.Ippudu phone open chesthe daily new ideas kanipisthayi.

Kaani danitho oka problem kuda vachindi.Constant comparison.

Social media lo people mostly best photos post chestaru.Perfect outfit,perfect lighting,perfect location anni kalisi untayi.Manam avi chusi mana own appearance ni compare cheskuntam.

Sometimes oka outfit manaki nachakapoyina,trend kabatti konali anipisthundi.Oka particular brand popular ayithe,manaki kuda adi undali anipisthundi.

Fashion ni enjoy cheyadam wrong kaadu.Kaani fashion valla self-confidence depend avvakudadu.

Trends temporary.Trend change ayina pratisari manam mana wardrobe change cheyalem.Anduke trend ni inspiration laga use cheyali,rules laga kaadu.

Inko interesting thing enti ante,social media traditional fashion ni kuda popular chesthundi.Regional sarees,handmade jewellery,traditional crafts and local clothing styles ippudu global audience ki reach avuthunnayi.

Ante social media modern fashion ni matrame promote cheyadam kaadu.Traditional fashion ki kuda new audience create chesthundi.

Naaku anipisthundi social media ni fashion inspiration kosam use cheyachu.Kaani final choice mana comfort and personality batti undali.

Trend follow cheyadam okay.Mana own style maintain cheyadam even better.

Social media fashion trends గురించి ఇంకో point,body positivity movement గురించి.Ippudు social media లో slowly different body types,different skin tones representation పెరుగుతోంది.ఇది positive change,endukante mundu fashion industry చాలా narrow standards follow చేసేది.Kaani ఇంకా చాలా improvement avసరం.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ప్రతి person తమ body ని accept చేసుకుని,దానికి suit అయ్యే fashion ఎంచుకోవాలి,ఏదో ఒక unrealistic standard కి try చేయకుండా.Alage micro-influencers rise కూడా ఒక interesting trend,వాళ్ళు relatable content ఇస్తారు,expensive brands మాత్రమే కాకుండా affordable options కూడా చూపిస్తారు.Ee variety valla fashion inka accessible మరియు inclusive గా మారుతోంది.Finally,social media ni healthy గా use చేయడం అంటే,inspiration తీసుకోవడం,కానీ మన self-worth ని likes leda comments meeda depend చేయకపోవడం.

script28.category: Fashion, Personal Style and Changing Trends
script28.title: Traditional and Modern Fashion
script28.content:
India lo fashion gurinchi matladithe traditional clothing gurinchi mention cheyakunda undalem.Mana country lo prathi region ki different clothing styles unnayi.

Saree,kurta,dhoti,lehenga,salwar and many regional dresses ki own designs and styles untayi.Festivals,weddings and special occasions lo traditional clothes ki chala importance untundi.

Kaani daily life lo modern clothing ekkuva common aipoyindi.College lo jeans and shirts wear cheyachu.Office lo formal clothes wear chestam.Friends tho outing ki casual clothes prefer chestam.

Interesting thing enti ante,traditional and modern styles ippudu mix kuda avuthunnayi.Traditional patterns ni modern clothes lo use chestunnaru.Traditional jewellery ni western outfits tho combine chestunnaru.Saree ni different modern styles lo wear chestunnaru.

Idi fashion change avuthunna way ni show chestundi.

Traditional fashion ni preserve cheyadam ante old style ni exactly same way lo wear cheyali ani kaadu.Daniloni designs,crafts and ideas ni modern style tho combine cheyachu.
