Handloom and handmade clothes ki kuda ippudu new interest vastundi.People local products konadaniki interest chupisthunnaru.Endukante handmade clothing lo unique feeling untundi.

Traditional clothes ki emotional value kuda untundi.Oka saree grandmother nunchi mother ki,tarvata daughter ki pass avvachu.Appudu adi just cloth kaadu.Oka family memory.

Modern fashion fastga change avuthundi.Kaani traditional fashion lo stories and memories untayi.

Naaku rendu styles lo balance chala beautifulga anipisthundi.Traditional clothing mana roots ni represent chesthe,modern clothing mana present lifestyle ni represent chestundi.

Rendu kalisi kuda oka person own style ni create cheskovachu.

Traditional and modern fashion గురించి ఇంకో point,fusion wear గురించి.Ippudు designers traditional fabrics,embroidery,and patterns ని modern silhouettes తో combine చేస్తున్నారు.Indo-western outfits,fusion sarees,and modern kurtas with traditional prints ivanni popular ayipoyాయి.Idi నాకు fashion evolution యొక్క beautiful example గా అనిపిస్తుంది.Alage weddings లో కూడా ee trend కనిపిస్తుంది,brides mరియు grooms traditional attire లో modern touches add చేసుకుంటున్నారు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ఇది cultural dilution కాదు,cultural evolution.Prathi generation తమ identity ni కొత్త రూపంలో express చేసుకుంటుంది.Handloom weavers కూడా ee fusion trend valla కొత్త audience ni చేరుకుంటున్నారు,వాళ్ళ craft ki కొత్త relevance dorుకుతోంది.Finally,fashion ఎప్పుడూ static గా undadు,adi society తో పాటు grow అవుతుంది,మరియు traditional-modern fusion ఆ growth కి ఒక beautiful example.

script29.category: Fashion, Personal Style and Changing Trends
script29.title: Fashion, Confidence and Self-Expression
script29.content:
Fashion gurinchi think chesthe chala mandi beauty and appearance gurinchi first think chestaru.Kaani naaku fashion ante confidence and self-expression kuda.

Manam em wear chestham anedi sometimes mana mood ni kuda affect chestundi.Oka important day unte manam konchem carefully dress cheskuntam.Dress neatga undi ani feel ayithe,confidence kuda konchem increase avvachu.

Kaani confidence only clothes nunchi raadani kuda remember cheyali.Expensive clothes vesukunna person automatically confident avvadu.Simple clothes vesukunna person confidence lekunda untadu ani kuda kaadu.

Fashion is just one part.

Manam vere vallani impress cheyadaniki constantly dress cheskunte,pressure increase avuthundi.Evaru em antaru?Na outfit bagunda?Trend lo unda?Ila think chesthu unte fashion enjoyment kanna stress aipothundi.

Instead,manaki comfortablega anipinche clothes choose cheskovali.

Body shape,height,color or appearance gurinchi society chala opinions chepthundi.Kaani every person different.Prathi person ki same clothes same way lo suit avvavu.Anduke self-acceptance important.

Fashion ni mana body ni change cheyadaniki use cheyakunda,mana personality ni express cheyadaniki use cheyachu.

Simple person simple outfit choose cheskovachu.Colorful personality unna person bright colors choose cheskovachu.Traditional style istam unna person traditional clothes wear cheyachu.

There is no single correct fashion.

Important thing enti ante,manam vesukunna outfit lo comfortablega feel avvali and ourselves ga feel avvali.

Naaku fashion ante other people approval kosam change avvadam kaadu.Mana own personality ni confidence tho show cheyadam.

Eventually,style is not about wearing the most expensive thing.It's about wearing something and feeling,this is me.

Fashion confidence గురించి ఇంకో point,minimalism గురించి.Ippudు chala mandi minimalist wardrobe వైపు move avutunnaru,quality over quantity ani believe chేస్తున్నారు.Konni versatile,well-fitting clothes కలిగి ఉండటం,chala mandi trendy but rarely-worn clothes కంటే better అని artham చేసుకుంటున్నారు.Idi నాకు practical గా అనిపిస్తుంది,endukante wardrobe simple ga unte,daily morning decisions కూడా easy గా untayi.Alage minimalism valla money kూడా save అవుతుంది,and environment meeda impact కూడా తగ్గుతుంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,confidence ki wardrobe size తో సంబంధం లేదు.Konni good pieces,మనకి బాగా suit అయ్యేవి,chala clothes కంటే ఎక్కువ confidence istayi.Finally,fashion journey ante constantly కొత్త trends వెంట పరిగెత్తడం కాదు,మనకి నిజంగా ఏది నచ్చుతుందో,ఏది comfortable గా అనిపిస్తుందో discover చేసుకోవడం.

script30.category: Fashion, Personal Style and Changing Trends
script30.title: Sustainable and Smart Fashion
script30.content:
Fashion industry chala fastga grow avuthundi.Every few weeks new trends vastayi.New collections,new designs,new styles constantly market lo untayi.

Kaani ee fast fashion tho oka question kuda vastundi.Manam prathi trend kosam kotha clothes konalsina avasaram unda?

Sometimes oka dress just two or three times wear chesi side lo pettestham.Endukante trend change aipothundi leda manaki boringga anipisthundi.

Idi money ki waste avvadam tho paatu unnecessary waste ni kuda create chestundi.

Anduke sustainable fashion gurinchi ippudu ekkuva mandi think chestunnaru.Sustainable fashion ante fashion completely stop cheyadam kaadu.Mana clothes ni konchem responsiblega use cheyadam.

Quality unna clothes koni,long time use cheyachu.Old clothes ni donate cheyachu.Reuse cheyachu.Mana wardrobe lo already unna clothes ni different combinations lo wear cheyachu.

Shopping ki vellinappudu,naaku idi really kavala ani think cheyadam useful.

Just discount undi ani konadam kanna,really use chestama ani think cheyali.

Local and handmade products kuda consider cheyachu.Some traditional clothes and crafts local workers and small businesses ni support chestayi.

Fashion enjoy cheyadam wrong kaadu.Trends follow cheyadam kuda wrong kaadu.Kaani little awareness tho shopping chesthe better.

Money save avuthundi.Clothes waste tagguthundi.Local businesses ki support untundi.

Inka important thing,wardrobe fullga undi ani style automatically better avvadu.Few good clothes ni smartga combine cheskunte chala different looks create cheyachu.

Naaku anipisthundi future fashion ante only new trends kaadu.Smart choices kuda.

Fashion should make us feel good,but at the same time,manam environment and money gurinchi kuda konchem think cheyali.

Endukante good fashion ante stylishga kanipinchadam maatrame kaadu.\*\*Smartga choose cheskovadam kuda fashion lo oka part.\*\*

##### **7.# \*\*Telugu Film Industry — TFI, Movies and the Love for Cinema\*\***

Sustainable fashion గురించి ఇంకో point,thrift and second-hand shopping గురించి.Ippudు chala young people thrift stores,second-hand markets వైపు మొగ్గు చూపిస్తున్నారు.Idi కేవలం money save చేయడానికి కాదు,environment ni protect చేయడానికి కూడా.Fast fashion valla textile waste chala పెరిగింది,and ee waste ni తగ్గించడానికి reuse and recycle important.Alage clothes swap events,rental fashion for special occasions ivanni కొత్త trends గా వస్తున్నాయి.Wedding leda party కోసం oka expensive outfit konte,adi ఒక్కసారి matrame use avvachu.Rent చేసుకుంటే,money and resources రెండూ save అవుతాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,sustainable fashion ante style ni sacrifice చేయడం కాదు,smart గా,responsible గా choices చేయడం.Future generations కోసం ఆలోచిస్తే,మన fashion choices కూడా planet meeda ఒక impact వేస్తాయని గుర్తుంచుకోవాలి.

script31.category: Telugu Film Industry — TFI, Movies and the Love for Cinema
script31.title: Why Movies Are So Important to Us
script31.content:
Mana life lo movies ki oka special place undi.Antha mandi cinema lovers kaakapoyina,almost everyone ki oka favourite movie,favourite song leda favourite actor untaru.Chinnappudu movie ante just entertainment anipisthundi.Kaani age perigina tarvata cinema anedi entertainment tho paatu emotions and memories kuda create chestundani artham avuthundi.

Especially Telugu states lo cinema ki unna craze chala differentga untundi.Oka new movie release ayithe social media motham aa movie gurinche discussions tho fill aipothundi.Trailer ela undi,songs ela unnayi,hero look ela undi,story ela untundi ani release mundhe chala expectations create avuthayi.

Theatre ki friends tho velladam kuda oka experience.Film start avvakamundu excitement,first scene ki reactions,interval lo discussions,climax tarvata movie gurinchi matladukovadam...ivanni cinema experience lo part.

Kaani naaku movies lo most interesting thing emotions.Manam screen meeda oka character ni chusthu vallatho connect avutham.Vallu happyga unte manam happyga feel avvachu.Vallu emotional scene lo unte manaki kuda emotion ravachu.

Some movies manaki oka lesson istayi.Some movies just entertainment kosam untayi.Some movies mana childhood ni gurthu chestayi.Inkonni movies mana life lo difficult time lo chusina memories tho connect aipothayi.

Anduke movie complete ayina tarvata kuda konni scenes manatho untayi.Oka dialogue,oka song,oka character leda oka emotion years tarvata kuda gurthu undochu.

Cinema is not always about whether the movie was good or bad.Sometimes it is about how that movie made us feel.

Anduke TFI and Indian cinema lo naaku most interesting thing enti ante,people ni connect cheyagalige power.

Movies గురించి ఇంకో point,నాకు anipisthundi cinema mana stress relief కోసం ఎంత important అని.Oka busy week తర్వాత theatre కి వెళ్ళి konni గంటలు reality నుండి బయటకి రావడం,oka different world లో live చేయడం,idi mana mental health కి కూడా మంచిది.Alage movies మనకి different perspectives కూడా చూపిస్తాయి.Different regions,different lifestyles,different struggles గురించి తెలుసుకోవడానికి cinema oka window లాగా పని చేస్తుంది.Naaku గుర్తుంది chinnapudu chusina konni movies ippటికీ naa values ni shape చేశాయి.Family bonding,friendship,courage లాంటి themes ఉన్న movies naaku life lessons kూడా nేర్పించాయి.Anduke cinema entertainment matrame కాదు,oka teacher కూడా,intentionally aina,unintentionally aina.Finally,cinema power enti ante,adi manalni oka stranger story తో కూడా connect చేయగలదు,and ఆ connection valla manam betterగా empathize cheయగలుగుతాము.

script32.category: Telugu Film Industry — TFI, Movies and the Love for Cinema
script32.title: The Growth of TFI
script32.content:
Telugu Film Industry gurinchi matladithe,past few years lo chala big changes jarigayi.Earlier Telugu movies mostly Telugu states and some Indian audiences varake strongga reach ayyayi.Kaani ippudu situation completely differentga undi.

Telugu films national and international audiences ki reach avuthunnayi.Dubbing,subtitles and streaming platforms valla language barrier konchem reduce ayyindi.

Big scale movies tho paatu,small stories kuda audiences ni attract chestunnayi.People just hero,heroine or budget kosam movie chudatam kaadu.Story interestingga unda?Characters believable ga unnaya?Emotion connect avuthunda?Ani kuda think chestunnaru.

Technology kuda cinema making ni change chesindi.CGI,VFX,better cameras and improved sound valla filmmakers bigger worlds create cheyagalugutunnaru.

Kaani technology alone movie ni successful cheyadu.Story and emotion still important.

TFI lo different types of movies vastunnayi.Action,comedy,romance,family dramas,thrillers,horror,experimental films and many other genres.

Streaming platforms kuda oka big change.Anthe kaadu,theatre lo release ayina movie few months tarvata home lo kuda chudagalugutunnam.

Audience expectations kuda change ayyayi.People now different language films kuda chustunnaru.Malayalam,Tamil,Kannada,Hindi and international movies Telugu audiences ki kuda easyga available unnayi.

Dani valla competition kuda increase ayyindi.Filmmakers ki audience expectations betterga understand cheyalsina situation vachindi.

Naaku anipisthundi TFI growth ki biggest reason talent tho paatu audience openness kuda.People new stories accept chestunnaru,different genres try chestunnaru and regional cinema ni world ki introduce chestunnaru.

Future lo TFI inka different stories and new ideas tho grow avuthundi ani expect cheyachu.

TFI growth గురించి ఇంకో point,women in filmmaking గురించి.Ippudు slowly TFI లో more women directors,writers,and technicians వస్తున్నారు.Ee change chala important,endukante different perspectives valla కొత్త రకమైన stories రావడానికి chance ఉంటుంది.Alage regional collaborations కూడా పెరిగాయి,Telugu,Tamil,Hindi,Kannada industries కలిసి pani చేయడం common ayipoyindi.Idi valla resources,talent,and audiences share అవుతున్నాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,pan-India films ఒక కొత్త era ni సూచిస్తున్నాయి,ఇందులో language barrier అనేది ఇక పెద్ద obstacle కాదు.Independent and low-budget films కూడా ఇప్పుడు streaming platforms valla audience ni చేరుకోగలుగుతున్నాయి,mundు theatre release లేకపోతే వాటికి visibility దొరకడం కష్టం ఉండేది.Ee democratization valla కొత్త talent కి కూడా avకాశాలు పెరుగుతున్నాయి.Future లో TFI inka more diverse,more experimental గా grow అవుతుందని నేను ఆశిస్తున్నాను.

script33.category: Telugu Film Industry — TFI, Movies and the Love for Cinema
script33.title: Actors and the Connection With Audiences
script33.content:
Cinema gurinchi matladetappudu actors gurinchi matladakunda undalem.Endukante oka character ni audience ki memorable ga chesedi actor performance.

Mana favourite actor movie release ayithe,movie story teliyakapoina kuda excitement untundi.Why?Because over the years manam vallani different characters lo chusam.Valla movies tho memories create chesam.

Chinnappudu oka actor movie chusi enjoy chesi,years later same actor movie ni theatre lo chudatam oka different feeling.

Actors ki fans tho relationship kuda interestingga untundi.Fans movie updates follow chestaru,posters chustaru,songs enjoy chestaru,first day theatre ki velladaniki excitement chupistaru.

Kaani actor success ante just fans count or opening numbers maatrame kaadu.Good performance kuda important.

Oka actor different roles try chesthe audience ki new experience vastundi.Comedy character chesina actor serious role chesthe,manam vallani different perspective lo chudagalugutham.

Sometimes actors oka particular character tho so strongly connect aipotharu,people real life lo kuda vallani aa character peru tho gurthu pettukuntaru.

Kaani cinema anedi teamwork.Actor okkade movie ni create cheyadu.Director,writer,camera team,music director,editor,art team,stunt team and hundreds of people behind the scenes work chestaru.

Audience mostly screen meeda kanipinche actors ni gurthu pettukuntaru.Kaani oka movie successful avvadaniki chala mandi effort untundi.

Anduke cinema industry ni chusthe,naaku biggest lesson teamwork.

Oka person talent important.Kaani many people kalisi work chesthe final output create avuthundi.

Actors audience ki face ayina,behind them there is a huge team.

Actors and audience connection గురించి ఇంకో point,fan culture గురించి.Telugu states లో fan following oka unique phenomenon,ఇది కేవలం movies కి matrame పరిమితం కాదు,personal relationship లాగా feel అవుతుంది.Fans favorite actor ni family member లాగా treat చేస్తారు,వాళ్ళ success ni సొంత success లాగా celebrate చేస్తారు.Idi extreme గా poతే konni సార్లు unhealthy కూడా కావచ్చు,kaani balanced గా unte,idi oka beautiful community bonding experience.Alage social media valla actors and fans direct గా connect అవుతున్నారు,ఇది before impossible ga ఉండేది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ee connection valla actors కి కూడా బాధ్యత పెరుగుతుంది,వాళ్ళు చెప్పే మాటలు,చేసే పనులు fans meeda direct impact వేస్తాయి.Finally,healthy fan culture అంటే admiration తో పాటు respect ఉండాలి,and actors కూడా వాళ్ళ platform ని positive గా use చేయాలి.

script34.category: Telugu Film Industry — TFI, Movies and the Love for Cinema
script34.title: Songs, Emotions and Movie Memories
script34.content:
Telugu cinema lo songs ki oka separate importance undi.Oka movie story gurthu undakapoyina,song మాత్రం years tarvata kuda gurthu undochu.

Mana childhood lo vinna songs konni ippatiki automaticga mind lo play avuthayi.Oka particular song vintene school days gurthu ravachu.Friends tho travel chesina time gurthu ravachu.Oka festival memory leda family function gurthu ravachu.

Idi music power.

Movie songs just entertainment kosam kaadu.Sometimes song story lo emotion ni explain chestundi.Hero happyga unte happy song,emotional situation lo emotional song,celebration lo energetic song...music story ni inka strongga feel cheyadaniki help chestundi.

Background music kuda same.Movie lo oka simple scene music tho completely different emotion create cheyagaladu.

Anduke cinema ni eyes tho maatrame kaadu,ears tho kuda experience chestham.

TFI lo music ki long history undi.Different generations lo different music styles popular ayyayi.Mana parents ki nachina songs different undochu.Mana generation ki different songs istam undochu.Kaani good music language and generation boundaries cross cheyagaladu.

Sometimes oka song meaning completega artham kaakapoyina manaki nachuthundi.Because melody and emotion language kanna ekkuva communicate cheyagalavu.

Naaku personal ga songs lo most beautiful thing memories create cheyadam.

Oka movie theatre lo chusina moment marchipovachu.Kaani aa movie song randomga few years later ekkado vinipisthe,aa entire memory malli gurthu ravachu.

Anduke cinema and music mana life lo just entertainment kaadu.They become part of our memories.

Songs and movie memories గురించి ఇంకో point,nostalgia గురించి.Konni పాటలు oka particular time,oka particular person,leda oka particular feeling తో connect అయిపోతాయి.Years తర్వాత ఆ song వినినప్పుడు,వెంటనే ఆ memory వెనక్కి వస్తుంది.Idi music యొక్క power,adi manalni time travel చేయించగలదు.Alage family functions,road trips,college days ivanni specific songs తో associate అయిపోతాయి.Naaku గుర్తుంది konni songs chinnapudu family తో కలిసి విన్నవి,ఇప్పటికీ అవి వినినప్పుడు ఆ warmth feel అవుతుంది.Movie songs కేవలం entertainment కాదు,ఇవి mana personal history లో markers లాగా పని చేస్తాయి.Finally,ఒక మంచి song ఎప్పటికీ old అవ్వదు,endukante adi కేవలం music కాదు,దానితో attached అయిన emotions and memories కూడా.

script35.category: Telugu Film Industry — TFI, Movies and the Love for Cinema
script35.title: The Future of TFI and Indian Cinema
script35.content:
Future cinema ela untundo think chesthe chala interestingga anipisthundi.Ippatike cinema chala change ayyindi.Theatres tho paatu streaming platforms unnayi.Subtitles and dubbing valla different languages movies easyga reach avuthunnayi.

Future lo language barriers inka reduce avvachu.A Telugu movie ni vere country lo unna person subtitles tho enjoy cheyagaladu.Ade way lo manam Korean,Japanese,Spanish or other language movies ni easyga chudagalugutunnam.

Technology kuda inka improve avuthundi.Better visual effects,better sound,better cameras and new filmmaking tools filmmakers ki more possibilities istayi.

Kaani technology entha develop ayina,story importance matram continue avuthundi.

People still want stories that make them laugh,cry,think or feel connected.Amazing visuals movie ni attractive ga cheyachu.Kaani memorable movie avvali ante emotion and good storytelling important.

TFI future lo regional stories ni global audience ki teesukellagaladu.Mana villages,mana cities,mana traditions,mana problems,mana humour and mana emotions ni different countries people kuda experience cheyagalru.

At the same time,manam other cultures stories ni kuda accept chestham.

Cinema world slowly one big connected space laga maruthundi.

Naaku future TFI gurinchi excitingga anipinche thing enti ante,new filmmakers ki opportunities increase avvadam.Camera and technology accessible ga avvadam valla different people different stories cheppagalugutunnaru.

Every movie blockbuster avvalsina avasaram ledu.Some movies small audience kosam create avvachu.Some movies big entertainment kosam untayi.Some movies social message kosam untayi.

Finally,cinema is a form of storytelling.

TFI change avvachu,technology change avvachu,audience preferences change avvachu.Kaani people stories vinadaniki,characters tho connect avvadaniki and emotions experience cheyadaniki always interested ga untaru.

Anduke cinema future lo kuda mana life lo important part ga continue avuthundi.

### **8.# \*\*Women Empowerment, Independence and Changing Society\*\***

#####

TFI future గురించి ఇంకో point,technology and storytelling గురించి.Ippudు AI,virtual production,and advanced editing tools valla filmmakers కొత్త రకమైన stories చెప్పగలుగుతున్నారు,before impossible అనిపించినవి కూడా ఇప్పుడు possible అవుతున్నాయి.Kaani technology ఎంత advance ayina,మంచి story యొక్క importance ఎప్పటికీ తగ్గదు.Alage audiences కూడా inka mature ayipోతున్నారు,వాళ్ళు కేవలం star power కోసం matrame కాదు,content quality కోసం కూడా movies select చేసుకుంటున్నారు.Idi filmmakers ని better content create చేయడానికి push చేస్తుంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,future లో TFI inka more experimental genres,inka more women-centric stories,and inka more realistic content తీసుకువస్తుంది.Streaming platforms valla small-budget,unique stories కూడా audience ని చేరుకునే chance పెరుగుతుంది.Cinema ఎప్పటికీ evolve అవుతూనే ఉంటుంది,కానీ manalni కథలతో connect చేయాలనే దాని core purpose ఎప్పటికీ మారదు.

script36.category: Women Empowerment, Independence and Changing Society
script36.title: What Women Empowerment Means
script36.content:
Women empowerment ante naaku first gurthochedi women ki freedom and equal opportunities ivvadam.Kaani empowerment ante just job cheyadam leda money earn cheyadam maatrame kaadu.Woman tana life gurinchi own decisions teesukogalige confidence kuda empowerment lo part.

Chinnappudu konni girls ki certain things boys tho compare chesthe different rules untayi.Ekkadiki vellali,entha time bayata undali,em dress vesukovali,em career choose cheskovali ani family and society konni expectations pettachu.Some rules safety kosam undochu,kaani sometimes unnecessary restrictions kuda untayi.

Time tho society slowly change avuthundi.Ippudu girls education meeda ekkuva focus undi.Women doctors,engineers,teachers,scientists,business owners,artists and many other fields lo work chestunnaru.

Kaani empowerment ante women men ni beat cheyali ani kaadu.Men and women ki equal respect and equal opportunities undali ani.

Education chala important.Education valla woman ki knowledge vastundi,confidence vastundi,anduke own decisions teesukovadaniki strength kuda vastundi.

Financial independence kuda important.Money earn cheyadam valla woman ki tana basic needs kosam completely depend avvalsina situation tagguthundi.

Kaani every woman compulsory ga job cheyali ani kuda kaadu.Some women career choose chestaru.Some family ni full-time care chestaru.Some business chestaru.Some studies continue chestaru.Every choice ki respect undali.

Empowerment ante woman ki choice undali.Ame life ni society decide cheyakunda,ame own decisions teesukune freedom undali.

Naaku anipisthundi real empowerment start ayedi childhood nunchi.Girls ni confidentga penchali.Their opinions vinvali.Their education ni importantga treat cheyali.Their dreams ni seriousga teesukovali.

Women strongga undali ani cheppadam kanna,they can become strong ani opportunities ivvadam more important.

At the end,women empowerment is not about giving women special treatment.It is about giving them the same chance to learn,grow,work,decide and live with dignity.

Women empowerment గురించి ఇంకో point,mentorship గురించి.Chala successful women vаళ్ళ journey లో oka mentor leda role model valla motivate అయ్యారు అని చెప్తారు.Anduke ఇప్పుడు established women తమ experience ni next generation తో share చేయడం చాలా important.Workplace mentorship programs,women-only networking groups,and community support systems ivanni ee process ni easier చేస్తాయి.Alage media లో women ni ఎలా represent చేస్తారు అనేది కూడా empowerment meeda impact చూపిస్తుంది.Strong,independent,and complex women characters చూపించడం valla young girls కి కొత్త possibilities కనిపిస్తాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,empowerment అనేది individual effort matrame కాదు,ఇది oka collective responsibility.Families,schools,workplaces,and media అన్నీ కలిసి pని చేస్తే,change faster గా వస్తుంది.Finally,ప్రతి woman కి ఆమె సొంత definition of success ఎంచుకునే freedom ఉండాలి,and society ఆ choices ni respect చేయాలి.

script37.category: Women Empowerment, Independence and Changing Society
script37.title: Education and Women
script37.content:
Women empowerment gurinchi matladetappudu education gurinchi first mention cheyali.Endukante education oka person life ni completely change cheyagaladu.

Oka girl ki good education dorikithe,ame world ni betterga understand cheskogaladu.Tana rights gurinchi telusukogaladu,career options gurinchi telusukogaladu,financial matters gurinchi learn cheyagaladu and important decisions confidence tho teesukogaladu.

Earlier generations lo konni places lo girls education ki same importance ivvaledu.Family responsibilities or other reasons valla studies earlyga stop chesina girls kuda unnaru.

Kaani ippudu situation slowly change avuthundi.More girls colleges ki velthunnaru,different careers choose chestunnaru and higher education continue chestunnaru.

Education valla benefits woman ki maatrame kaadu,entire family ki untayi.Educated person children education and health gurinchi better decisions teesukovachu.Financial matters ni betterga understand cheskovachu.

Kaani education ante certificates collect cheyadam maatrame kaadu.Thinking ability,confidence,communication and awareness kuda education lo part.

Girls ki education ichinappudu vallaki only job kosam prepare cheyatledu.Life ni own ga handle cheskovadaniki prepare chestunnam.

Parents role ikkada chala important.Girl and boy iddariki same importance tho education provide cheyali.Girl ki studies complete cheyadam avasaram ledu ani anukokudadu.

Inka important thing,education ki age limit ledu.Young age lo opportunity miss ayina,life lo later kuda learn cheyachu.

Naaku anipisthundi society develop avvali ante women education strongga undali.

Oka educated woman tana life ni improve cheskovachu.Tana family ni support cheyachu,children ki better opportunities ivvachu and society lo kuda contribute cheyachu.

Anduke women empowerment ki first strong step education.

Women education గురించి ఇంకో point,rural areas గురించి.Urban areas లో education access చాలా వరకు improve ఐనా,rural areas లో ఇంకా challenges ఉన్నాయి.Distance,safety concerns,and financial constraints valla చాలా మంది girls education మధ్యలో ఆపేస్తారు.Anduke government schemes,scholarships,and community awareness programs ee gap ni తగ్గించడానికి important.Alage digital education వల్ల rural areas లో కూడా girls quality content access చేయగలుగుతున్నారు,ఇది oka positive change.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ప్రతి గ్రామంలో ఒక్క girl కూడా education నుండి miss అవ్వకూడదు.Local role models,ఆ ఊరిలోనే చదివి successful ఐన women stories,ఇతర girls ni inspire చేస్తాయి.Community support,ముఖ్యంగా fathers and brothers support,girls education ని continue చేయడంలో పెద్ద difference చేస్తుంది.Finally,educated girl ఒక్క family ని matrame కాదు,ఆ మొత్తం community ని uplift చేయగలదు.

script38.category: Women Empowerment, Independence and Changing Society
script38.title: Financial Independence
script38.content:
Women empowerment lo financial independence ki chala importance undi.Money anedi life lo everything kaadu.Kaani money decisions meeda basic control undadam chala important.

Oka woman earn chesthe,ame tana needs ni own ga manage cheskovachu.Tana goals kosam save cheskovachu.Family expenses lo contribute cheyachu.And unexpected situation vachina appudu konchem independentga handle cheyagaladu.

Kaani financial independence ante every woman high salary earn cheyali ani kaadu.Some women business chestaru.Some jobs chestaru.Some freelance work chestaru.Some family responsibilities ni manage chestu financial decisions lo participate chestaru.

Important thing choice and understanding.

Woman money earn cheyakapoyina,financial matters gurinchi knowledge undali.Income entha,expenses entha,savings ela cheyali,banking ela use cheyali ani basic knowledge useful.

Sometimes women family kosam chala work chestaru.Kaani house work ki salary undadu ani,adi valuable kaadu ani think cheyadam wrong.Household work and caring for family kuda real work.

At the same time,woman ki career kavali ante support cheyali.Job cheyali anukunte "family ni evaru chusukuntaru?" ani only woman ni question cheyakunda,house responsibilities ni family members share cheskovali.

Financial independence woman ki confidence ivvagaladu.Kaani financial independence tho paatu financial responsibility kuda important.

Money earn chesi motham spend cheyakunda,savings and future planning kuda nerchukovali.

Naaku empowerment ante woman ki money meeda control undadam,career choice undadam,and financial decisions lo voice undadam.

Money gives freedom,but knowledge gives better control.

Anduke women financial education and independence society lo inka encourage cheyali.

Financial independence గురించి ఇంకో point,entrepreneurship గురించి.Ippudు chala women సొంత businesses start చేస్తున్నారు,home-based నుండి large-scale వరకు.Social media valla marketing easy ayipoyindి,ఒక్క person కూడా చిన్న investment తో business start చేయగలుగుతున్నారు.Idi flexibility istundi,ముఖ్యంగా family responsibilities తో పాటు work చేయాలనుకునే women కి.Alage microfinance and women-focused loan schemes కూడా చాలా మందికి help చేస్తున్నాయి,business start చేయడానికి capital దొరకడంలో.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,entrepreneurship women కి కేవలం income matrame కాదు,decision-making power మరియు identity కూడా ఇస్తుంది.Vాళ్ళు తమ own business run చేసినప్పుడు,confidence naturally పెరుగుతుంది.Finally,financial independence యొక్క ultimate goal choice,job cheయాలన్నా,business cheయాలన్నా,leda family ni prioritize చేయాలన్నా,ఆ నిర్ణయం woman సొంతంగా తీసుకోగలగాలి.

script39.category: Women Empowerment, Independence and Changing Society
script39.title: Breaking Stereotypes
script39.content:
Society lo chala years nunchi konni ideas unnayi.Boys ila undali,girls ila undali ani.Certain jobs boys ki suitable ani,certain responsibilities girls ki natural ani konni stereotypes create ayyayi.

Kaani ippudu women almost every field lo prove chestunnaru.Women engineering lo unnaru,medicine lo unnaru,technology lo unnaru,sports lo unnaru,army lo unnaru,business lo unnaru,politics lo unnaru and many other fields lo work chestunnaru.

Aina stereotypes completely disappear avvaledu.

Oka girl career meeda seriousga focus chesthe,she is too ambitious ani anachu.Oka woman family kosam work choose cheskunte,she is not ambitious ani anachu.Ela chusina society sometimes judgement chestundi.

Anduke empowerment ante women ni oka single image lo fit cheyakunda,individual choices ni respect cheyadam.

Every woman same type of life lead cheyalsina avasaram ledu.

Oka woman career kosam city change cheyavachu.Inkokaru hometown lo undi business start cheyavachu.Marikokaru family responsibilities choose cheskovachu.Inkokaru travel cheyavachu.Choices differentga undochu.

Important thing society force cheyakunda choice undadam.

Men kuda stereotypes valla pressure face chestaru.Men always strongga undali,emotions show cheyakudadu,family responsibilities motham handle cheyali ani expectations untayi.So equality benefits everyone.

Women empowerment ante women ki freedom ivvadam tho paatu,men and women iddarini unnecessary expectations nunchi free cheyadam.

Naaku anipisthundi real change laws tho maatrame raadu.Mana thinking lo change ravali.

Girls ki "nuvvu girl kabatti idi cheyalemu" ani cheppadam taggali.Boys ki "idi girls work" ani cheppadam kuda taggali.

Ability gender meeda depend avvadu.

Opportunity dorikithe person em cheyagalado society chudali.

Breaking stereotypes గురించి ఇంకో point,sports గురించి.Ippudు women different sports లో అద్భుతంగా perform చేస్తున్నారు,cricket,badminton,boxing,wrestling ఇలా చాలా fields లో.Kaani ఇంకా వాళ్ళకి పురుషులతో పోలిస్తే తక్కువ recognition,తక్కువ pay,and తక్కువ media coverage దొరుకుతోంది.Idi change avvalsina area.Alage school and college level లోనే girls ni sports లోకి encourage చేయడం important,endukante early exposure valla vాళ్ళలో confidence and discipline develop అవుతాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ప్రతి field లో,adi sports అవ్వచ్చు,science అవ్వచ్చు,leda business అవ్వచ్చు,talent కి gender లేదు.Society ee fact ni ఎంత త్వరగా అర్థం చేసుకుంటే,అంత త్వరగా అందరికీ equal opportunities create అవుతాయి.Finally,stereotypes break అవ్వాలంటే,ఒక్క generation సరిపోదు,continuous effort and awareness అవసరం.

script40.category: Women Empowerment, Independence and Changing Society
script40.title: The Future of Women Empowerment
script40.content:
Women empowerment gurinchi ippudu chala discussions jaruguthunnayi.Kaani future lo actual change ela untundi anedi mana next generation meeda depend avuthundi.

Nenu future society ni imagine chesthe,girls and boys iddariki childhood nunchi equal opportunities undali ani anipisthundi.

Education lo equal chance undali.Career choose cheskune freedom undali.Financial decisions lo confidence undali.Public spaces lo safety undali.Workplace lo respect undali.

Women ni empower cheyadaniki women maatrame responsible kaadu.Family,schools,workplaces and society motham contribute cheyali.

Parents girls ni confidentga penchali.Valla opinions vinvali.Their dreams ni encourage cheyali.At the same time,boys ki kuda respect,equality and responsibility gurinchi childhood nunchi teach cheyali.

Because future generation thinking change ayithe,society naturally change avuthundi.

Women empowerment ante women ni men tho compete cheyadaniki prepare cheyadam kaadu.Women ki own identity and choices tho life lead cheyadaniki space create cheyadam.

Ame career choose cheskunte support cheyali.Ame family choose cheskunte respect cheyali.Ame business start cheyali anukunte encourage cheyali.Ame higher studies cheyali anukunte opportunity ivvali.

Most importantly,her choice ni seriousga teesukovali.

Society lo women safe ga,confidentga and respected ga feel ayithe,adi just women ki benefit kaadu.Entire society better avuthundi.

Women educated ayithe families benefit avuthayi.Women financially independent ayithe families stronger avvachu.Women leadership positions lo unte new ideas ravachu.

Future India lo women participation inka increase avvali ani nenu hope chesthunnanu.

Finally,women empowerment ante oka campaign leda oka slogan kaadu.It is a continuous change in how we think,how we treat people and how we create opportunities.

Simplega cheppalante,woman ki wings ivvadam kanna,ame already unna wings ni cut cheyakunda undadam kuda empowerment.

Ame own path choose cheskoni,confidence tho munduku vellagaligite,ade real empowerment.

### **9.# \*\*Education and Technology — Changing the Way We Learn\*\***

Future of women empowerment గురించి ఇంకో point,men's role గురించి.Empowerment అనేది కేవలం women issue కాదు,ఇది society issue,and అందులో men role కూడా important.Fathers తమ daughters ని sons లాగే equal గా penchడం,husbands తమ wives career ni support చేయడం,brothers తమ sisters choices ni respect చేయడం,ivanni చిన్న steps లాగా అనిపించినా,పెద్ద change తీసుకువస్తాయి.Alage workplaces లో equal pay,maternity మరియు paternity leave policies,and safe work environment ivanni structural changes కూడా అవసరం.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,future లో empowerment అనే మాటే avసరం లేని ఒక society create చేయాలనేది goal ఉండాలి,అంటే equality అనేది default గా ఉండాలి,special effort గా కాదు.Ee change ఒక్కరోజులో రాదు,కానీ ప్రతి small step,ప్రతి conversation,and ప్రతి supportive action ఆ దిశగా తీసుకువెళ్తుంది.

script41.category: Education and Technology — Changing the Way We Learn
script41.title: How Technology Changed Education
script41.content:
Education ante school or college ki velladam,books chadavadam,exams rayadam ani chinnappudu anukunevallam.Kaani technology vachina tarvata education meaning konchem change ayyindi.Ippudu learning classroom lo maatrame jaragadam ledu.Phone,laptop or tablet unte almost anywhere nunchi kuda learn cheyachu.

Earlier oka topic artham kakapothe teacher ni next day adagalasi vachedi.Ippudu same topic gurinchi online lo search chesi,videos chusi,different explanations vini understand cheskovachu.

Online classes kuda education ni chala change chesayi.Student intlo undi class attend cheyagaladu.Recorded lessons unte,manaki convenient time lo malli chudachu.Evarikaina oka concept first time artham kakapothe,video pause chesi,malli chusi practice cheyachu.

Technology valla information access kuda easy ayyindi.Oka book kosam library ki vellalsina situation chala cases lo undadu.Oka topic gurinchi articles,videos,notes and examples online lo dorukutayi.

Kaani technology undi kabatti learning automatic ga improve avvadu.Manam technology ni ela use chestham anedi important.

Phone lo learning app open chesi,five minutes tarvata social media ki vellipothe technology help cheyadu.Distraction kuda technology tho easyga vastundi.

Anduke technology ni tool laga use cheyali,teacher replacement laga kaadu.Teacher oka concept ni explain chesi,student doubt clear cheyagaladu.Mana learning ni understand chesi correct direction ivvagaladu.

Technology and teachers kalisi work chesthe education inka betterga untundi.

Naaku anipisthundi future education completely online leda completely offline undadu.Rendu kalisi untayi.Classroom lo teacher guidance untundi,technology tho additional learning untundi.

Students ki kuda responsibility increase avuthundi.Evaru force cheyakapoyina self-learning cheyagalige ability develop cheskovali.

Finally,technology education ni easyga access cheyadaniki help chestundi.Kaani learning jarigedi technology valla kaadu.Mana interest,effort and consistency valla.

Technology manaki door open chestundi.Kaani aa door nunchi lopaliki vellalsindi maname.

Technology in education గురించి ఇంకో point,gamification గురించి.Ippudు chala learning apps games లాగా design చేయబడ్డాయి,points,levels,and rewards తో.Idi ముఖ్యంగా చిన్న పిల్లలకి learning ni fun గా చేస్తుంది,traditional boring methods కంటే.Alage AI-powered apps ప్రతి student weakness ni identify చేసి,personalized practice ఇవ్వగలుగుతున్నాయి.Idi oka big advantage,endukante prathi student ki different pace,different learning style ఉంటుంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,technology valla education inka accessible మరియు engaging ఐంది,కానీ screen time ni balance చేయడం కూడా important.Physical activities,face-to-face interactions,and hands-on learning ni కూడా ignore చేయకూడదు.Finally,best approach technology ni oka tool గా use చేయడం,replacement గా కాదు.Teachers and technology కలిసి పని చేస్తే,students కి richest learning experience దొరుకుతుంది.

script42.category: Education and Technology — Changing the Way We Learn
script42.title: Online Learning and Self-Learning
script42.content:
Online learning gurinchi think chesthe,naaku first gurthochedi freedom.Eppudu learn cheyali,ekkada learn cheyali,em topic learn cheyali ane choices konchem mana hands lo untayi.

Traditional classroom lo teacher oka particular speed lo lesson complete chestaru.Some students ki adi perfect speed ga untundi.Some students ki fastga anipinchachu.Inkonthamandiki slowga anipinchachu.Online learning lo konchem flexibility untundi.

Oka difficult topic unte video ni pause cheyachu.Rewind cheyachu.Malli start nunchi chudachu.Different teacher explanations kuda try cheyachu.

Idi especially self-learning ki useful.

For example,oka student ki coding nerchukovali anukundam.College subject kosam maatrame wait cheyakunda,online courses,videos and practice websites use chesi daily learn cheyachu.

Same thing languages,music,design,business and many other skills ki apply avuthundi.

Kaani online learning lo biggest challenge discipline.

Classroom lo teacher mundu untaru kabatti manam attend avutham.Online lo nobody is watching.Manam video open chesi,pause chesi,phone pakkana petti vere things chuse chance untundi.

Sometimes course purchase chestham,first few days chala excitement untundi.Tarvata slowly interest taggipothundi.

Anduke online learning lo motivation kanna routine important.Daily thirty minutes ayina consistentga learn chesthe long term lo result vastundi.

Inko important thing source selection.Online lo information chala ekkuva undi.Kaani every video or article correct ani assume cheyakudadu.Reliable sources choose cheyali.

Also,just videos chudatam learning kaadu.Watch chesina concept ni practice cheyali.Notes prepare cheyali.Questions solve cheyali.Project leda activity cheyali.

Appude actual understanding vastundi.

Naaku anipisthundi technology valla education democratize ayyindi.Ante learning opportunities ekkuva mandiki reach avuthunnayi.

Location,money or college limitations konni cases lo reduce avvachu.

Kaani finalga online learning success avvali ante,self-discipline,self-learning and patience important.

Technology teacher ni replace cheyadam kanna,student ki more opportunities ivvadam lo powerful tool.

Online learning గురించి ఇంకో point,self-discipline గురించి.Online courses flexibility istayi,కానీ ఆ flexibility valla discipline maintain చేయడం కష్టం కూడా అవుతుంది.Evaru control చేయకపోతే,procrastination easy గా అవుతుంది.Anduke self-learners కి time management మరియు goal-setting skills చాలా important.Alage online learning communities,discussion forums,and study groups ee isolation feeling ni తగ్గించడానికి help చేస్తాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,online learning success కి motivation key factor.Course ni ఎందుకు చేస్తున్నామో clear గా తెలిస్తే,consistency maintain చేయడం easy అవుతుంది.Certificates మాత్రమే కాదు,నిజంగా nేర్చుకోవడం మీద focus చేస్తే,long-term లో ఎక్కువ benefit ఉంటుంది.Finally,online learning ఒక powerful tool,కానీ దాన్ని సరిగ్గా ఉపయోగించుకోవడం మన చేతుల్లోనే ఉంటుంది.

script43.category: Education and Technology — Changing the Way We Learn
script43.title: Technology, Teachers and Students
script43.content:
Technology education lo chala important role play chestunna,teacher importance matram taggipoledu.Nijam cheppalante,technology information istundi,but teacher direction istaru.

Internet lo oka topic search chesthe hundreds of results vastayi.Appudu beginner ki which one correct?Which one first learn cheyali?Which topic tarvata learn cheyali?Ani confusion ravachu.

Teacher ikkada guide chestaru.

Oka student mistake chesthe,teacher aa mistake ni identify chesi correct cheyagaladu.Oka student confidence lose ayithe,teacher motivate cheyagaladu.Oka concept student ki difficultga anipisthe,different way lo explain cheyagaladu.

Technology ki ee human connection completega undadu.

At the same time,teachers kuda technology ni use cheskunte teaching inka interestingga cheyachu.

Presentations,videos,animations,online quizzes and digital examples use chesi difficult concepts ni easyga explain cheyachu.

For example,science lo oka process textbook lo words tho chadavadam kanna,animation lo chusthe easyga understand avvachu.Geography lo map ni digitalga explore cheyadam more interestingga undochu.

Students kuda technology ni active learning kosam use cheyachu.

Class lo doubt vachinappudu immediatega note cheskoni,later research cheyachu.Different examples search cheyachu.Practice tests attempt cheyachu.

Kaani one problem undi.Information ekkuva ayina,attention span taggipovachu.

Notifications,social media and entertainment apps students focus ni disturb cheyagalavu.

Anduke digital discipline important.Phone and laptop learning kosam use chesthunappudu distractions control cheyali.

Technology ni blame cheyadam easy.But technology ni correctga use cheyadam mana responsibility.

Naaku future classroom ante teacher board mundu stand avvadam and students notebooks lo rayadam maatrame kaadu.Teacher,students and technology togetherga work chese environment.

Teacher guidance istaru.Technology resources istundi.Student effort pedathadu.

Ee three kalisi work chesthe education more personal and effectivega avvachu.

So technology teacher ni replace cheyadaniki raaledu.It can help teachers teach better and students learn better.

Technology, teachers and students గురించి ఇంకో point,digital divide గురించి.Ippudు అందరికీ good internet,laptops,or smartphones అందుబాటులో లేవు.Ee divide valla కొంతమంది students technology benefits పొందుతుంటే,మరికొంతమంది వెనుకబడిపోతున్నారు.Anduke government and schools ee gap ni bridge చేయడానికి try చేయాలి,affordable devices,free internet access,and community learning centers ద్వారా.Alage teachers కి కూడా regular training అవసరం,కొత్త technology ni effectively use చేయడానికి.Idi లేకపోతే technology పెద్దగా value add చేయదు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,technology ఎంత advance ఐనా,ఒక మంచి teacher యొక్క role ఎప్పటికీ replace అవ్వదు.Teachers students ki motivation istaru,emotional support istaru,ఇవి ఏ app కూడా ఇవ్వలేదు.Finally,technology and human connection కలిసి ఉన్నప్పుడే education నిజంగా effective గా ఉంటుంది.

script44.category: Education and Technology — Changing the Way We Learn
script44.title: AI and the Future of Education
script44.content:
Ippudu education gurinchi matladetappudu AI gurinchi mention cheyakunda undalem.AI already students learning style ni konni ways lo change chestundi.

Earlier oka doubt vaste,book open chesi search cheyali leda teacher ni adigali.Ippudu AI tools tho immediate explanation pondavachu.

Oka difficult topic ni simple words lo explain cheyamani adagachu.Oka example create cheyamani adagachu.Oka practice question generate cheyamani adagachu.Mana answer lo mistake ekkada undo kuda konni tools identify cheyagalavu.

Idi students ki chala useful.

Kaani AI ni wrong way lo use chesthe problem kuda create avuthundi.

For example,assignment vachina ventane AI tho complete answer generate chesi,understand cheyakunda submit chesthe,student ki actual learning jaragadu.

Exam kosam prepare avvakunda,AI every answer istundi ani depend ayithe,student own thinking ability slowly reduce avvachu.

Anduke AI ni shortcut laga kakunda learning assistant laga use cheyali.

First manam problem ni solve cheyadaniki try cheyali.Stuck ayithe AI ni hint kosam use cheyachu.Answer vachina tarvata,why this answer ani understand cheyali.

AI manaki answer ivvagaladu.Kaani answer ni understand cheyadam mana responsibility.

Future lo education inka personalized avvachu.Oka student ki difficult topic ekkuva practice ivvachu.Inko student ki advanced questions ivvachu.Learning speed batti resources suggest cheyachu.

Kaani human teachers role importantga untundi.Teachers students emotions,behavior and personal difficulties ni understand cheyagalru.

AI ki knowledge undochu,but human connection different.

Naaku future education lo AI ni fear tho chudalsina avasaram ledu.Responsibly use chesthe chala useful tool.

Important thing enti ante,technology manaki think cheyakunda undadaniki use avvakudadu.Manam inka betterga think cheyadaniki use cheyali.

AI answer kosam use cheyadam kanna,AI tho better questions adagadam nerchukunte inka valuable.

AI and education గురించి ఇంకో point,critical thinking గురించి.AI tools valla information easily దొరుకుతుంది,కానీ దానితో పాటు critical thinking కూడా nేర్పించడం important.Students AI ఇచ్చిన answers ని blindly accept చేయకుండా,వాటిని question చేయడం,verify చేయడం nేర్చుకోవాలి.Alage AI valla routine tasks automate అవుతున్నాయి కాబట్టి,creativity,problem-solving,and emotional intelligence లాంటి human skills future లో inka ఎక్కువ value కలిగి ఉంటాయి.Education system ee skills ni prioritize చేయాలి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,AI teachers ని replace చేయదు,కానీ teachers role change అవుతుంది.Vాళ్ళు కేవలం information ivvకుండా,students ni how to think,ఎలా analyze చేయాలి,ఎలా create చేయాలి అని guide చేస్తారు.Finally,future education లో AI oka powerful assistant,కానీ human judgment and creativity ఎప్పటికీ center లో ఉంటాయి.

script45.category: Education and Technology — Changing the Way We Learn
script45.title: Equal Access to Education Through Technology
script45.content:
Education gurinchi alochisthe,oka important question vastundi.Andariki equal learning opportunities unnaya?

Every student ki same facilities undavu.Konthamandiki good schools untayi,fast internet untundi,laptop untundi and additional courses ki access untundi.Inkonthamandiki basic resources kuda limitedga undochu.

Technology ee gap ni konni ways lo reduce cheyagaladu.

Oka student remote village lo unna,phone and internet access unte,world lo unna educational resources ni access cheyagaladu.Oka subject lo best teacher vere city lo unna,online classes dwara aa teacher lessons chudachu.

Language options kuda increase avuthunnayi.Videos subtitles tho chudachu.Different languages lo explanations dorukutunnayi.

Idi education ki chala big opportunity.

Kaani digital access itself kuda oka challenge.Andariki good internet,devices or quiet study environment undakapovachu.

Anduke technology introduce cheyadam tho problem completega solve avvadu.Basic digital access kuda improve cheyali.

Students ki device use cheyadam nerpinchali.Safe internet usage gurinchi explain cheyali.Information correct aa kaada ani check cheyadam kuda teach cheyali.

Education ante information collect cheyadam maatrame kaadu.How to think,how to question,how to communicate and how to solve problems ani nerchukovadam.

Technology ee process ni support cheyagaladu.

Future lo education more accessible avvali ani hope cheyachu.Oka student's location or background valla learning opportunities completely limit avvakudadu.

Kaani technology alone society ni change cheyadu.Teachers,parents,schools,governments and students andaroo kalisi work cheyali.

Naaku technology yokka biggest power entertainment lo kaadu,learning opportunities create cheyadam lo undi anipisthundi.

Oka simple phone oka student ki new skill nerpinchagaladu.Oka online lesson oka person's career direction change cheyagaladu.Oka useful video oka difficult concept ni easyga cheppagaladu.

Anduke technology ni responsiblega use chesthe,education ni fasterga maatrame kaadu,more accessiblega and more flexiblega kuda cheyagalugutam.

Finally,education is the foundation,and technology can be one of the strongest tools to make that foundation available to more people.

### **10.# \*\*India's Development, Human Rights and Accountability\*\***

Equal access to education గురించి ఇంకో point,language barriers గురించి.Chala educational content English లో matrame అందుబాటులో ఉంటుంది,ఇది non-English speaking students కి disadvantage.Anduke regional language content increase చేయడం important,technology valla translation and dubbing ఇప్పుడు easier అయ్యింది.Alage free and open educational resources,libraries,and community learning centers ee access gap ni తగ్గించడానికి help చేస్తాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,education ఒక privilege కాకుండా,ఒక basic right గా అందరికీ అందుబాటులో ఉండాలి.Government,NGOs,and private organizations కలిసి pని చేస్తే,ee goal సాధించడం possible.Finally,real equality అంటే prathi child,vాళ్ళు ఎక్కడ ఉన్నా,ఏ language matladinా,ఏ economic background నుండి వచ్చినా,quality education పొందే chance ఉండాలి.

script46.category: India's Development, Human Rights and Accountability
script46.title: Development Starts With Responsible Citizens
script46.content:
India develop avvali ani manam chala sarlu matladukuntam.Kotha roads kavali,better buildings kavali,more companies ravali,jobs increase avvali ani anukuntam.Ivi anni important.Kaani development ante infrastructure maatrame kaadu.People lives better avvadam kuda development lo part.

Oka city lo beautiful roads unna,people traffic rules follow cheyakapothe problem untundi.Oka place lo dustbins unna,people garbage roads meeda padesthe clean environment raadhu.Oka government scheme unna,people danini correctga use cheyakapothe expected result raadu.

Anduke India development lo citizens role chala important.

Manam government ni questions adagadam important.Government public money ni ela use chestundi?Projects correctga jaruguthunnaya?Public services people ki reach avuthunnaya?Ani accountability undali.

Kaani government ni question cheyadam tho paatu,manam kuda accountable ga undali.

Manam rules follow chestunnama?Public property ni protect chestunnama?Taxes correctga pay chestunnama?Others rights ni respect chestunnama?Environment ni care chestunnama?

Human rights kuda development lo important part.Every person ki dignity,respect,safety and equal opportunities undali.A person poor ga unnadu ani vallani less importantga treat cheyakudadu.A person different background nunchi vachadu ani vallaki fewer opportunities ivvakudadu.

Education,healthcare and basic facilities andariki accessible ga undali.

India develop avvali ante government okkate work cheyadam saripodu.Citizens,schools,businesses,organisations and government andaroo kalisi work cheyali.

Naaku anipisthundi development oka big project tho start avvadu.Small responsible actions tho start avuthundi.

Oka person garbage correct place lo vesthe small thing.Oka driver traffic rule follow chesthe small thing.Oka student sincerega study chesthe small thing.Kaani millions of people same thing chesthe,result hugega untundi.

At the end,better India kosam manam government nunchi expectations pettukovali.Kaani mana responsibility ni kuda marchipokudadu.

\*\*Development starts with the country,but it also starts with each citizen.\*\*

Responsible citizens గురించి ఇంకో point,civic sense గురించి.Public places clean గా ఉంచడం,traffic rules follow చేయడం,queue లో wait చేయడం ivanni చిన్న habits లాగా అనిపించినా,ఇవి society యొక్క overall quality ni reflect చేస్తాయి.Anduke ee habits ni చిన్నప్పటి నుండే పిల్లలకి nేర్పించడం important.Alage community involvement కూడా important,local cleanliness drives,tree plantation,or awareness campaigns లో participate చేయడం valla ownership feeling develop అవుతుంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,development అంటే కేవలం government పనులు matrame కాదు,ప్రతి citizen తమ చిన్న responsibility సరిగ్గా నెరవేర్చడం.Millions of people ఒకే విధంగా behave చేస్తే,పెద్ద change వస్తుంది.Finally,better India కోసం మనం government ని matrame కాదు,మనల్ని మనం కూడా accountable గా ఉంచుకోవాలి.

script47.category: India's Development, Human Rights and Accountability
script47.title: Education, Jobs and a Stronger India
script47.content:
India develop avvali ante first education and employment gurinchi think cheyali.Naaku anipisthundi,oka country strength buildings or technology tho maatrame measure cheyakudadu.A country lo people ki unna opportunities kuda important.

Oka student ki good education dorikithe,valla future completely change avvachu.Education valla knowledge maatrame kaadu,confidence and better decisions teesukune ability kuda vastundi.

Kaani education andariki same quality lo available undali.City lo unna student ki good resources doriki,village lo unna student ki basic facilities kuda dorakakapothe gap create avuthundi.

Technology ee gap ni konni ways lo reduce cheyagaladu.Online classes,digital learning and educational resources valla remote areas lo unna students kuda different subjects nerchukovachu.Kaani internet and devices access kuda improve cheyali.

Education tarvata employment kuda equally important.

Students years chaduvukoni,skills develop cheskoni,job opportunities lekapothe frustration increase avuthundi.India lo new businesses,small companies and large industries increase avvali.More jobs create avvali.

Kaani jobs create cheyadam tho paatu,fair opportunities kuda important.Person background,gender,religion or financial situation valla unnecessary discrimination undakudadu.

Idi human rights tho directly connected.

Every person ki work chese opportunity undali,workplace lo respect undali and unfair treatment face cheyakudadu.

At the same time,companies and organisations kuda accountable ga undali.Employees ni fairga treat cheyali,salaries correctga ivvali,safe working environment provide cheyali.

Government kuda policies create chesthe,avi ground level lo actualga work chestunnaya ani check cheyali.

Development ante statistics improve avvadam maatrame kaadu.Oka family better education pondadam,oka student job pondadam,oka worker safe workplace lo work cheyadam,oka small business grow avvadam...ivi kuda development.

Naaku India future strongga undali ante people ki opportunities create cheyadam biggest priorities lo okati.

\*\*Educated people,skilled people and equal opportunities create a stronger country.\*\*

Education, jobs and stronger India గురించి ఇంకో point,skill development గురించి.Ippudు job market fast గా change అవుతోంది,and traditional degree మాత్రమే సరిపోదు.Anduke vocational training,internships,and practical skills చాలా important అయిపోతున్నాయి.Government and private sector కలిసి skill development programs ni strengthen చేస్తే,youth better employment opportunities పొందగలరు.Alage entrepreneurship ni encourage చేయడం కూడా important,endukante ప్రతి person job seeker గా undakunda,job creator గా కూడా మారగలరు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,strong India కి strong education system మరియు strong job market రెండూ అవసరం.Rural areas లో కూడా ee opportunities reach అయితే,migration pressure తగ్గి,balanced development జరుగుతుంది.Finally,educated,skilled,and employed youth ఏ దేశానికైనా biggest asset.

script48.category: India's Development, Human Rights and Accountability
script48.title: Human Rights and Equality
script48.content:
Human rights ane word vintene chala big concept laga anipisthundi.Kaani simplega cheppalante,prathi person ni human being ga respect cheyadam.

Oka person rich aina poor aina,educated aina uneducated aina,city lo unna village lo unna,their basic dignity and respect samega undali.

Sometimes society lo people ni valla background batti judge chestham.Oka person em job chestunnaru ani chusi vallani respect chestham leda disrespect chestham.Oka person poor ga unte vallani less importantga treat chestham.

Idi change avvali.

Human rights ante prathi person ki basic respect,safety and fair treatment undali.

Education lo discrimination undakudadu.Workplace lo unfair treatment undakudadu.Public places lo people safe ga feel avvali.Children ki education and protection undali.

Women ki equal opportunities undali.People with disabilities ki proper access undali.Older people ki respect and support undali.

Human rights gurinchi matladetappudu responsibilities kuda gurthu pettukovali.

Mana rights important.Ade time lo vere person rights ni respect cheyadam kuda mana responsibility.

For example,freedom of expression undi ani vere person ni intentionally hurt cheyadam correct kaadu.Mana freedom vere person freedom ni damage cheyakudadu.

Ikkada accountability kuda important.

Evaraina position lo unnaru ani vallaki rules apply avvakunda undakudadu.Authority unna person mistake chesthe question cheyagalige system undali.

Government officials,companies,organisations and ordinary citizens...andariki responsibility undali.

Accountability ante mistake chesina person ni punish cheyadam maatrame kaadu.Mistake enduku jarigindi ani understand chesi,malli repeat avvakunda system improve cheyadam kuda.

India develop avvali ante economic growth important.But growth tho paatu equality and dignity kuda important.

Oka country wealthy ga undi,kaani people unsafe ga feel chesthe,adi complete development kaadu.

Naaku development ante people ki better life dorakadam.

\*\*A country becomes truly developed when its people are not only successful,but also respected and protected.\*\*

Human rights and equality గురించి ఇంకో point,awareness and education గురించి.చాలా మందికి తమ basic rights గురించి కూడా పూర్తి అవగాహన లేదు.Anduke schools లో మరియు community programs లో human rights గురించి teach చేయడం important.Alage marginalized communities కి legal aid and support systems accessible గా ఉండాలి,వాళ్ళు తమ rights ని exercise చేయగలగాలి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,equality అనేది కేవలం law లో matrame ఉండకూడదు,daily life లో practice అవ్వాలి.Prathi person,వాళ్ళ religion,caste,gender,or economic background తో సంబంధం లేకుండా,dignity తో treat చేయబడాలి.Finally,ఒక దేశం నిజంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిందా లేదా అనేది,దాని most vulnerable citizens ని ఎలా treat చేస్తుందో దాన్ని బట్టి తెలుస్తుంది.

script49.category: India's Development, Human Rights and Accountability
script49.title: Government, Public Money and Accountability
script49.content:
India lo government chala important role play chestundi.Roads,schools,hospitals,public transport,water,electricity and many other services kosam government systems work chestayi.

Ee services kosam public money use avuthundi.Anduke government accountability chala important.

Public money ante government own money kaadu.It belongs to the people.

Taxes and other sources nunchi government ki money vastundi.Aa money correct purpose kosam use avuthunda?Projects qualityga complete chestunnara?People ki actual benefit reach avuthunda?Ani questions adagadam citizens right.

Accountability ante government ni constantly blame cheyadam kaadu.Government decisions transparentga undali,people ki information available ga undali,and mistakes jarigithe responsible people answer ivvali.

For example,oka road construction kosam money allocate chesaru anukundam.Road quality poor ga unte,people question cheyagalali.Project ki entha money allocate chesaru?Evaru responsible?Why did the quality fail?Ani investigate cheyali.

Alage citizens kuda responsible ga undali.Public property damage chesi,tarvata government ni blame cheyadam correct kaadu.

Democracy lo citizens role election roju vote cheyadam tho complete avvadu.Government work ni observe cheyadam,information telusukovadam and responsible decisions teesukovadam kuda important.

Human rights kuda government accountability tho connected.

Government institutions people ni protect cheyadaniki work cheyali.People ki fair treatment undali.Services discrimination lekunda reach avvali.

Oka poor person ki government hospital service dorakali.Oka child ki education opportunity undali.Oka woman safe ga public place use cheyagalali.Oka disabled person ki basic facilities accessible ga undali.

Ivi luxuries kaavu.Basic needs.

Naaku anipisthundi strong government ante questions accept cheyagalige government.Strong citizen ante questions adagadam tho paatu responsibility accept chese citizen.

Government and citizens madhya trust undali.That trust transparency and accountability tho build avuthundi.

\*\*A country develops faster when power comes with responsibility and responsibility comes with accountability.\*\*

Government accountability గురించి ఇంకో point,transparency గురించి.Ippudు RTI (Right to Information) వంటి tools valla citizens government పనుల గురించి information అడగగలుగుతున్నారు.Idi ఒక powerful tool,కానీ చాలా మందికి దీని గురించి పూర్తి అవగాహన లేదు.Anduke ee rights గురించి awareness పెంచడం important.Alage digital governance,online public records,and e-services valla transparency slowly పెరుగుతోంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,accountability అనేది ఒక two-way process.Government transparent గా ఉండాలి,మరియు citizens కూడా active గా question చేయాలి,vote చేయాలి,and participate చేయాలి.Finally,strong democracy కి informed and engaged citizens అవసరం,వాళ్ళు మౌనంగా ఉండకుండా,బాధ్యతగా ప్రశ్నించేవాళ్ళు.

script50.category: India's Development, Human Rights and Accountability
script50.title: Building the India We Want
script50.content:
Future India ela undali ani think chesthe,naaku first gurthochedi opportunities unna India.

Oka student ki good education kavali.Oka graduate ki suitable job kavali.Oka family ki affordable healthcare kavali.Oka woman ki safety and equal opportunities kavali.Oka worker ki fair salary and respectful workplace kavali.Oka elderly person ki proper support kavali.

Ivi different problems laga kanipinchina,actually anni development tho connected.

India develop avvali ante cities maatrame develop avvakudadu.Villages kuda develop avvali.Small towns kuda opportunities pondali.

Only big companies grow avvadam kaadu.Small businesses and local workers kuda grow avvali.

Technology develop avvali,but technology access kuda increase avvali.Education improve avvali,but education andariki reach avvali.

Economic growth important.Kaani growth benefits konthamandiki maatrame limit avvakudadu.

Human rights ikkada central role play chestayi.

Every person deserves dignity.Every child deserves education.Every worker deserves fair treatment.Every woman deserves safety.Every citizen deserves to be treated with respect.

At the same time,accountability undali.

Government accountable ga undali.Businesses accountable ga undali.Institutions accountable ga undali.Citizens kuda accountable ga undali.

Evaraina power lo unnaru ani rules above ga undakudadu.Alage ordinary citizen ani responsibilities nunchi escape avvakudadu.

Mana country ni improve cheyadaniki always huge changes kosam wait cheyalsina avasaram ledu.Mana daily actions tho start cheyachu.

Public places clean ga unchadam,traffic rules follow cheyadam,tax rules follow cheyadam,fake news share cheyakapovadam,others ni respect cheyadam,vote ni responsibly use cheyadam...ivi small actions.

Kaani country lo millions of people responsiblega behave chesthe,impact hugega untundi.

Naaku India future ante just richer India kaadu.Safer India,cleaner India,fair India and more equal India.

People ki opportunities undali,but opportunities tho paatu dignity kuda undali.

Government ki power undali,but aa power tho accountability kuda undali.

Citizens ki rights undali,but rights tho responsibilities kuda undali.

Finally,India development anedi government project maatrame kaadu.It is a shared responsibility.

Manam future India gurinchi matladetappudu,aa future ni create chese people kuda maname.

\*\*Better India kosam wait cheyakunda,better citizens ga maaradam tho start cheyali.\*\*

### **11.# \*\*Parents and Children — Understanding the Bond Between Them\*\***

Building the India we want గురించి ఇంకో point,unity in diversity గురించి.India యొక్క biggest strength దాని diversity,కానీ కొన్నిసార్లు ఈ diversity divisions కి కూడా దారితీస్తుంది.Anduke prathi citizen differences ni respect చేస్తూ,common goals కోసం కలిసి pని చేయడం nేర్చుకోవాలి.Alage youth ki ee vision ni carry చేసే responsibility ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది,endukante future వాళ్ళదే.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ideal India అంటే prathi citizen safe గా,equal గా,and hopeful గా feel అయ్యే country.Adi ఒక్క రోజులో create అవ్వదు,కానీ consistent effort,better education,and responsible citizenship valla slowly ఆ దిశగా move అవ్వచ్చు.Finally,India future prathi ఒక్కరి చేతుల్లో ఉంది,and ఆ బాధ్యత ni అర్థం చేసుకోవడమే మొదటి step.

script51.category: Parents and Children — Understanding the Bond Between Them
script51.title: What Parents Mean to Children
script51.content:
Parents ante chinnappudu manaki just amma,nanna laga anipistaru.Kaani age perigina tarvata vallaki mana life lo unna importance slowly artham avuthundi.

Chinnappudu manaki em kavali anna parents ni adugutham.New toy kavali ante vallani adugutham,school ki vellali ante vallatho vellam,problem vaste vallatho cheptham.Appudu parents mana world motham laga anipistaru.

Kaani teenage and college age ki vachina tarvata mana thinking change avuthundi.Mana own decisions teesukovali anipisthundi.Parents ekkuva questions adigithe irritation vastundi.Ekkadiki vellali,ekkadiki vellakudadu,entha sepu bayata undali ani chepthe sometimes control chestunnaru anipisthundi.

Kaani konchem age perigina tarvata artham avuthundi.Vallu control cheyadaniki kaadu,care tho adigaru ani.

Parents ki mana safety gurinchi fear untundi.Manam mistake chesthe em avuthundo ani worry untundi.Anduke konnisarlu valla advice manaki annoyingga anipinchina,valla intention mostly mana meeda care.

Parents perfect people kaadu.Vallu kuda mistakes chestaru.Vallaki anni answers teliyavu.Vallu kuda life ni first time live chestunnaru.

Kaani oka difference undi.Vallaki mana future gurinchi chala genuine concern untundi.

Chinnappudu parents manaki everything provide chestaru.Age perigina tarvata manam vallaki support avvalsina stage vastundi.Appudu roles konchem change avuthayi.

Naku anipisthundi parents ni understand cheyadam ante vallatho every decision lo agree avvadam kaadu.Vallani human beings laga chudatam.Vallaki kuda fears untayi,worries untayi,dreams untayi ani understand cheyadam.

Maybe one day manam kuda parents age ki vachina appudu,vallu enduku ala behave chesaro inka betterga artham avuthundi.

Parents mana life lo first teachers,first supporters and sometimes first people who believe in us.

Anduke vallani value cheyadam manam success ayyaka maatrame kaadu.Ippude cheyali.

Parents గురించి ఇంకో point,unconditional support గురించి.Life లో ఎన్ని ఎత్తు పల్లాలు వచ్చినా,parents usually ఒక్కటే constant గా ఉంటారు,మనం success ఐనా,failure ఐనా.Ee unconditional support ni చిన్నప్పుడు మనం normal గా తీసుకుంటాము,కానీ పెద్దయ్యాక దాని విలువ artham అవుతుంది.Alage parents మనకి teach చేసే small life lessons,discipline,honesty,hard work,ivi long-term లో మన character ni shape చేస్తాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,parents మనకి కేవలం physical needs matrame కాదు,emotional security కూడా istaru.Ame home ki వచ్చినప్పుడు feel అయ్యే safety and comfort,ఎక్కడా దొరకదు.Finally,parents role ni పూర్తిగా అర్థం చేసుకోవడం,మనం కూడా పెద్దయ్యి,బాధ్యతలు తీసుకున్నప్పుడే జరుగుతుంది.

script52.category: Parents and Children — Understanding the Bond Between Them
script52.title: Parents' Sacrifices and Children's Understanding
script52.content:
Parents sacrifices gurinchi manam chala sarlu vintam.Kaani chinnappudu aa word meaning completega artham kaadu.

Manaki new clothes kavali ante koni istharu.Manaki good school kavali ante arrange chestaru.Manam coaching ki vellali ante money spend chestaru.Manam comfortablega undali ani vallu konni own needs postpone chestaru.

Appudu avi normal things laga anipisthayi.

Kaani age perigina tarvata,mana own expenses start ayyaka konchem artham avuthundi.Money earn cheyadam easy kaadu.Time manage cheyadam easy kaadu.Responsibilities handle cheyadam kuda easy kaadu.

Appudu parents mana kosam entha effort pettaro slowly realize avutham.

Kaani parents sacrifices ante money maatrame kaadu.Valla time kuda sacrifice chestaru.

Oka parent tiredga unna child homework help cheyachu.Oka mother tana work madhyalo child kosam food prepare cheyachu.Oka father busy schedule unna child ni school or college ki drop cheyachu.Ivi small things laga kanipinchina,years ki chala memories create chestayi.

Parents konnisarlu mana kosam decisions teesukuntaru.Endukante vallaki mana future betterga undali ani untundi.

Kaani children perspective kuda important.

Every generation different.Mana parents grow ayina time lo opportunities differentga unnayi.Mana generation ki technology,different careers and different lifestyle options unnayi.

Anduke parents mana choices immediatega understand cheyakapovachu.Alage children kuda parents fears immediatega understand cheyakapovachu.

Ikkada communication important.

Parents sacrifices ni respect chestu,children own dreams ni kuda explain cheyali.

Love ante oka person kosam anni sacrifices cheyadam maatrame kaadu.Valla feelings and choices ni understand cheyadam kuda.

One day children independent ayina tarvata,parents ki money kanna mana time and attention important avvachu.

Anduke parents tho spend chese time ni value cheyali.

Because some sacrifices manam latega understand chesina,avi mana life lo already chala impact create chesi untayi.

Parents' sacrifices గురించి ఇంకో point,silent sacrifices గురించి.చాలా parent sacrifices పిల్లలకి కనిపించవు కూడా.Vాళ్ళు own dreams,own comforts,and own needs ni postpone చేసి పిల్లల future కోసం work చేస్తారు,ఇది చాలా సార్లు మాటల్లో express కూడా చేయరు.Anduke పిల్లలు గా మనం prathి small gesture ni గమనించడం,appreciate చేయడం important.Alage parents financial sacrifices matrame కాదు,emotional sacrifices కూడా చేస్తారు,పిల్లల కోసం patience,worry,and sleepless nights.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,thank you చెప్పడం చిన్న విషయం లాగా అనిపించినా,అది chala meaningful.Time గడిచేకొద్దీ,parents role ni recognize చేయడం,వాళ్ళని value చేయడం,ఇది relationship ని inka strong చేస్తుంది.Finally,sacrifices ni గుర్తుంచుకోవడం matrame కాదు,వాటిని respect తో reciprocate చేయడం కూడా important.

script53.category: Parents and Children — Understanding the Bond Between Them
script53.title: Parents' Expectations and Children's Dreams
script53.content:
Parents ki children meeda expectations undatam very natural.Chinnappati nunchi mana future gurinchi dreams untayi.Manchiga chadavali,good job ravali,life lo settle avvali ani parents korukuntaru.

Kaani konnisarlu parents expectations and children's dreams differentga untayi.

Parents ki oka career safe and securega anipinchachu.Child ki vere field meeda interest undochu.Appudu arguments start avvachu.

Child ki parents tana dreams ni understand cheyatledu anipisthundi.Parents ki child future ni seriousga teesukovatledu anipisthundi.

Actually rendu sides lo fear untundi.

Parents ki fear enti ante,child wrong decision teesukoni later suffer avvakudadu.

Child ki fear enti ante,tana life tana choice lekunda vere direction lo vellipokudadu.

Anduke e situation lo kuda communication important.

Children parents tho calmga matladali.Mana interest enti,enduku aa career kavali,danikosam em plan chestunnam ani explain cheyali.Just naaku idi ishtam ani cheppadam kanna,proper reason cheppadam better.

Parents kuda immediatega reject cheyakunda,child point of view listen cheyali.

Every child ki same dream undadu.Okariki doctor avvali anipinchachu.Inkokariki engineer avvali anipinchachu.Marikokariki business cheyali anipinchachu.Inkoka person ki creative field lo work cheyali anipinchachu.

Success ki one fixed path ledu.

Parents children ki guidance ivvali,but complete control cheyakudadu.

At the same time,children kuda parents experience ni completely ignore cheyakudadu.Vallu life lo already chala things experience chesaru.Valla advice lo useful points undochu.

Best solution fight kaadu.Balance.

Parents guidance and children's dreams rendu kalisi oka better decision create cheyagalavu.

Finally,parents children happyga undali ani korukuntaru.Children parents proudga feel avvali ani korukuntaru.

Rendu sides intention love nunchi vachinappudu,communication tho gap ni reduce cheyachu.

Parents' expectations గురించి ఇంకో point,redefining success together గురించి.Chala family లో success అంటే ఒక specific career,ఒక specific salary,leda ఒక specific lifestyle అని fixed idea ఉంటుంది.Kaani time తో ఈ definition change అవ్వాలి.Anduke parents మరియు children కలిసి,open గా,success ki కొత్త definition create చేసుకోవడం useful.Alage children కూడా parents fears ni అర్థం చేసుకుని,వాళ్ళ concerns ni address చేయడానికి try చేయాలి,కేవలం రిజెక్ట్ చేయకుండా.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,best relationship అంటే prathi ఒక్కరు తమ point ni వినిపించగలిగే,మరియు రెండు వైపులా compromise చేయగలిగే relationship.Finally,parents dreams and children dreams వేరు వేరు గా ఉన్నా,goal ఒక్కటే,ఇద్దరూ happy గా,fulfilled గా ఉండాలి.

script54.category: Parents and Children — Understanding the Bond Between Them
script54.title: When Children Grow Up
script54.content:
Children chinnappudu parents meeda completely depend avutharu.Amma food pedthundi.Nanna school ki teesukeltaru.Homework lo help chestaru.Sick ayithe care chestaru.

Kaani slowly child grow avuthadu.School nunchi college ki velthadu,tarvata job kosam vere city ki vellachu.Appudu parents and children madhya distance konchem increase avuthundi.

Physical distance tho paatu emotional distance kuda sometimes vastundi.

Earlier daily matladina child,ippudu busy ayyi two days call cheyakapovachu.Parents call chesthe later matladatha ani cheppi marchipovachu.Child ki adi normal busy life laga anipisthundi.Kaani parents ki aa small call chala important ayyi undochu.

Growing up lo roles change avuthayi.Child ki own life,career,friends and responsibilities vastayi.Parents ki kuda age perigina tarvata more support and companionship kavali.

Anduke independence vachina tarvata parents ni completely ignore cheyakudadu.

Independent avvadam ante parents nunchi distance create cheyadam kaadu.Mana life ni own ga manage chestu,parents tho relationship maintain cheyadam.

Sometimes children anukuntaru,parents ki money pampisthe responsibility complete ani.Kaani parents ki always money maatrame avasaram undadu.

Sometimes vallaki oka phone call kavali.Oka conversation kavali.Oka visit kavali.Manam ela unnam ani telusukovali.

At the same time,parents kuda children grow ayyarani accept cheyali.Childhood lo laga every decision lo interfere cheyakudadu.

Child ki own life undi,own responsibilities unnayi ani respect cheyali.

Healthy relationship ante both sides lo understanding undali.

Children parents ni respect cheyali.Parents children independence ni respect cheyali.

One day childhood memories ni remember chesinappudu,parents tho spend chesina small moments chala valuablega anipisthayi.

Anduke busy life unna,parents kosam time create cheyadam important.

Because growing up means becoming independent,but it doesn't mean becoming distant.

Children growing up గురించి ఇంకో point,role reversal గురించి.Time గడిచేకొద్దీ,పిల్లలే parents ని care చేసే responsibility తీసుకుంటారు.Ee role reversal natural,కానీ emotional గా కూడా కష్టం,ముఖ్యంగా parents ని weak అవుతూ చూసినప్పుడు.Anduke ee stage కోసం మానసికంగా prepare అవ్వడం,and patience తో handle చేయడం important.Alage parents కి కూడా ee change ni accept చేయడం కష్టం అవ్వచ్చు,వాళ్ళు independent గా ఉండాలని అనుకుంటారు.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ee transition ni respect తో handle చేయాలి,parents dignity ni maintain చేస్తూనే support చేయాలి.Finally,పిల్లలు గా పెరగడం అంటే,ఒక రోజు మనం మన parents కి అదే unconditional support ivvగలగడం,వాళ్ళు మనకి ఇచ్చినట్టు.

script55.category: Parents and Children — Understanding the Bond Between Them
script55.title: Parents and Children Understanding Each Other
script55.content:
Parents and children relationship lo biggest problem sometimes love lack avvadam kaadu.Understanding lack avvadam.

Parents children kosam worry chestaru.Kaani aa worry sometimes strictness laga kanipisthundi.Children freedom kavali ani anukuntaru.Kaani aa freedom parents ki carelessness laga anipinchachu.

Rendu sides lo love untundi.Kaani communication correctga lekapothe misunderstandings create avuthayi.

Children konnisarlu parents ni old-fashioned ani anukuntaru.Parents konnisarlu children ni immature ani anukuntaru.

Actually both sides ki konchem truth untundi.

Parents ki experience ekkuva undochu.Kaani present world gurinchi children ki better understanding undochu.Children ki technology and new opportunities gurinchi knowledge undochu.Kaani life experience parents daggara ekkuva undochu.

Anduke one side only correct ani anukovadam unnecessary.

Parents children tho friend laga matladagaligite,chala problems earlyga solve avvachu.Children kuda parents tho every problem hide cheyakunda share cheyagalige environment undali.

Alage children parents ni kuda listen cheyali.Valla fears and concerns ni immediately dismiss cheyakudadu.

Every generation ki different struggles untayi.Parents face chesina problems manam face cheyakapovachu.Mana generation face chese problems vallaki completely newga undochu.

Anduke comparison kanna understanding better.

Parents children ni protect cheyali,but over-control cheyakudadu.Children freedom enjoy cheyali,but responsibility marchipokudadu.

Eventually relationship strongga undali ante rendu sides effort pettali.

Parents children life ni respect cheyali.Children parents time and feelings ni value cheyali.

Oka stage lo children parents ki everything laga untaru.Tarvata children own life build cheskuntaru.Kaani relationship maintain cheyadaniki daily huge efforts avasaram ledu.

Oka phone call,oka conversation,oka visit,oka simple question — how are you? — sometimes chala enough.

Endukante parents and children madhya bond perfectga undalsina avasaram ledu.Understanding,patience and love unte chalu.

\*\*At the end,children grow up and parents grow older,but the need for each other never completely disappears.\*\*

## **12.# \*\*Friendship, Relationships and Changing Connections\*\***
