Parents and children understanding each other గురించి ఇంకో point,generation gap గురించి.Technology,social values,and lifestyle fast గా change అవుతున్నందుకు,parents and children madhya generation gap సహజంగా పెరుగుతుంది.Kaani ee gap ni bridge చేయడం possible,regular conversations,shared activities,and mutual respect valla.Alage children తమ world గురించి parents కి patience తో explain చేయాలి,and parents కూడా కొత్త ideas ni open mind తో వినాలి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,understanding ఒక్కరోజులో రాదు,adi చిన్న చిన్న moments నుండి build అవుతుంది,ఒక meal కలిసి తినడం,ఒక conversation,leda ఒక shared memory.Finally,parents and children ఎప్పుడూ prతి విషయంలో agree అవ్వాలి అని లేదు,కానీ ఒకరినొకరు గౌరవించడం,వినడం,ఇదే strong relationship కి foundation.

script56.title: What True Friendship Means
script56.content:
Friendship ante naaku just daily matladukune person leda kalisi tirige person ani anipinchadu.True friendship ante manam ela unna accept chese person.

School days lo friendship chala simplega untundi.Oka person tho daily kalisi lunch cheyadam,kalisi aadukovadam,small things share cheskovadam...anthe friendship aipothundi.Appudu friends ni choose chesetappudu money,status or future gurinchi think cheyam.

Age perigina tarvata friendship meaning konchem change avuthundi.Manaki evaraina happy moments lo support chesthe baguntundi.Kaani difficult time lo mana pakkana unde person important.

Manam successful ayinappudu congratulate chese friends chala mandi untaru.Kaani manam fail ayinappudu,manam low feel ayinappudu,without judging mana tho matlade friends very few.

True friend ante mana mistakes ni blindly support chese person kaadu.Mana mistake ani telisthe honestga cheppe person.

Sometimes friend cheppe truth manaki nachakapovachu.Kaani later alochisthe,aa person mana good kosame cheppadu ani artham avuthundi.

Friendship lo trust kuda chala important.Oka personal matter share chesinappudu,adi vere vallaki cheppakunda protect cheyadam important.

Alage friendship lo respect undali.Prathi person ki different opinions untayi.Different opinions vachinappudu friendship end avvalsina avasaram ledu.

Sometimes friends madhya arguments jaruguthayi.Matladukoni solve cheskunte relationship inka strong avvachu.

Naaku friendship lo biggest thing presence anipisthundi.Daily call cheyalsina avasaram ledu.Daily kalavalsina avasaram ledu.Kaani need vachinappudu call chesthe respond ayye person unte,chala valuable.

Life lo chala people vastaru.Konthamandi short time untaru.Konthamandi years untaru.Kaani konthamandi mana life lo memories laga permanentga undipotharu.

Maybe true friendship ante manam happyga unnappudu kalisi navvadam maatrame kaadu.Manam weakga unnappudu kuda mana pakkana undadam.

True friendship గురించి ఇంకో point,honesty గురించి.Real friend మనకి ఎప్పుడూ నచ్చినదే చెప్పడు,కొన్నిసార్లు మనకి కావాల్సిన truth కూడా చెప్తాడు,అది వినడానికి కష్టం ఐనా.Ee honesty valla friendship stronger అవుతుంది,endukante trust build అవుతుంది.Alage true friendship లో jealousy ki place ఉండదు.Friend success చూసినప్పుడు genuine గా happy అవ్వడం,ఇదే real friendship యొక్క sign.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,friendship ఎంత deep గా ఉన్నా,effort లేకపోతే adi కూడా fade అవ్వచ్చు.Anduke friends కోసం time and energy invest చేయడం important,busy life లో కూడా.Finally,true friend అంటే మనం ఎలా ఉన్నా,ఏం చేసినా,మనతో ఉండే వ్యక్తి,judgment లేకుండా,conditions లేకుండా.

script57.title: Friends During Different Stages of Life
script57.content:
Mana life lo friendship different stages lo differentga untundi.School friends,college friends,work friends and childhood friends...andaritho relationship samega undadu.

School days lo friends tho almost every day kalustham.Class lo kalisi kurchuntam,lunch share cheskuntam,exams gurinchi discuss chestham.School complete ayina tarvata life different directions lo vellipothundi.Konthamandi vere college ki vellachu,inkonthamandi vere city ki vellachu.

First lo daily matladina friends tho slowly weekly leda monthly matladatam start avvachu.Sometimes months kuda conversation undakapovachu.Kaani malli kalisinappudu,old connection immediatega return avvachu.

College friendship konchem different.College lo manam more independentga untam.Different backgrounds nunchi people ni kalustham.Different personalities ni understand chestham.Some friendships classes and projects tho start avvachu.Tarvata avi close relationships ga marachu.

College complete ayina tarvata again paths change avuthayi.Okariki job vastundi,inkokaru higher studies ki veltharu,inkokaru vere city ki shift avutharu.

Appudu friendship maintain cheyadam konchem difficult.

Work life start ayina tarvata time chala limited aipothundi.Morning work,evening travel,family responsibilities...anni kalisi friends kosam time takkuva aipothundi.

Kaani friendship ki always huge amount of time avasaram ledu.A simple message,a short call leda occasional meeting kuda connection maintain cheyadaniki enough.

Sometimes manam friends ni lose chesam ani feel avutham.Kaani actually friendship disappear avvaledu.Life responsibilities change ayyayi.

Every friendship lifetime continue avvalsina avasaram ledu.Konthamandi particular stage lo mana life ki importantga untaru.Vallu mana childhood ni shape cheyachu,inkonthamandi college memories create cheyachu.

Anduke friendship ni duration tho measure cheyakudadu.Years ekkuva undi kabatti relationship strong ani kaadu.Short time lo kuda oka person mana life meeda chala impact create cheyachu.

Life change avuthundi,people change avutharu,priorities change avuthayi.Kaani genuine connection unte,distance friendship ni completely destroy cheyadu.

Friends during different life stages గురించి ఇంకో point,workplace friendships గురించి.Job start ఐన తర్వాత,కొత్త friendships workplace లో develop అవుతాయి.Ee friendships different గా ఉంటాయి,professional boundaries తో పాటు personal connection కూడా ఉంటుంది.Alage marriage తర్వాత,couple friends గా కొత్త social circle create అవుతుంది.Ee transitions natural,and prathi stage లో కొత్త friendships కూడా ఎంతో value కలిగి ఉంటాయి.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,ప్రతి friendship ఒకే విధంగా ఉండాలని expect చేయకూడదు.School friends ఒక type,college friends inko type,and adult friends inko type experience istayi.Finally,life stages change అవుతున్నా,కొన్ని friendships అన్ని stages లో కూడా survive అవుతాయి,ఎందుకంటే వాటిలో genuine connection ఉంటుంది.

script58.title: When Friendships Change
script58.content:
Friendship gurinchi matladetappudu,friendships change avvadam kuda normal ani accept cheyali.

Chinnappudu best friend ani pilichina person,years tarvata mana life lo closega undakapovachu.First lo adi chala painfulga anipisthundi.Manam em mistake chesam?Enduku friendship change ayyindi?Ani think chestham.

Kaani sometimes nobody is wrong.Life itself changes.

Oka person vere city ki vellachu.Inkokariki new job ravachu.Marikokariki new responsibilities ravachu.Interests kuda change avvachu.

Earlier daily games gurinchi matladina friends,tarvata careers and family gurinchi matladukovachu.

Sometimes misunderstandings friendship ni damage chestayi.Oka small argument serious issue ga marachu.Okaru hurt ayina feeling cheppakapothe,distance slowly increase avvachu.

Anduke communication important.Something bothers us ante directga matladatam better.Assumptions tho relationship judge cheyakudadu.

Kaani every friendship ni save cheyali ani kuda compulsory kaadu.Some relationships unhealthyga marachu.Constant disrespect,jealousy,lying or unnecessary negativity unte,distance maintain cheyadam better.

Friendship ante sacrifice chestu manam unhappyga undadam kaadu.

Sometimes letting go is also part of growing up.

Oka friend mana life nunchi vellipoyina,aa friendship meaningless ani kaadu.Aa person tho spend chesina time,memories and lessons mana life lo part aipothayi.

Manam friendships ni hold cheskovadaniki try chestham.Endukante old memories ni lose avvadam ishtam undadu.Kaani people change avutharu.Mana interests change avuthayi.Mana priorities change avuthayi.

Anduke friendship change ayinappudu every time blame cheyalsina avasaram ledu.

Konthamandi mana life lo permanentga untaru.Konthamandi oka phase varaku untaru.Rendu kuda okay.

Important thing enti ante,relationship end ayina respect tho remember cheyagalagadam.

Maybe growing up ante konthamandi people mana life lo stay cheyarani accept cheyadam kuda.

Friendships changing గురించి ఇంకో point,forgiveness గురించి.Long-term friendships లో misunderstandings రావడం సహజం.Kaani ప్రతి చిన్న argument ni relationship end చేయడానికి reason గా తీసుకోకూడదు.Forgiveness మరియు moving forward చేసే ability strong friendships ki key.Alage ఒకరి mistake ని పదే పదే గుర్తు చేయడం,ఆ relationship ni slowly damage చేస్తుంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,healthy friendship లో apologize చేయడం మరియు forgive చేయడం రెండూ ఉండాలి.Ego ni పక్కన పెట్టి,relationship ni value చేయడం maturity.Finally,friendship లో perfect గా ఉండాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు,కానీ genuine గా,honest గా ఉండటం matters.

script59.title: Friends and Their Influence
script59.content:
Friends mana personality meeda chala influence create cheyagalru.Mana habits,thinking and decisions meeda kuda friends impact untundi.

Manam ekkuva time evaritho spend chesthamo,valla behavior konchem konchemga mana meeda influence avvachu.

Positive friends unte,manam better things try cheyadaniki motivation vastundi.Oka friend studies seriousga chesthe,manam kuda motivate avvachu.Oka friend fitness start chesthe,manaki kuda try cheyali anipinchachu.Oka friend new skill nerchukunte,manam kuda interest develop cheskovachu.

Kaani negative influence kuda untundi.

Sometimes friends pressure valla manam manaki ishtam leni things kuda chestham.Friends group lo everyone oka decision teesukunte,manam different opinion cheppadaniki hesitate avvachu.

Acceptance kosam mana own values ni compromise cheyadam dangerous.

True friend manalni wrong things cheyamani pressure cheyadu.Manam no ani cheppina respect chestadu.

Friendship lo peer pressure ane thing especially young age lo common.Smoking,drinking,unnecessary spending or risky activities try cheyamani friends encourage cheyavachu.

Appudu friendship kosam mana safety compromise cheyakudadu.

Good friend ante mana tho everything samega cheyali ani force chese person kaadu.Mana differences ni respect chese person.

Alage manam kuda friends ni control cheyakudadu.Vallaki own decisions untayi.Vallaki own life untundi.

Friends influence strongga untundi kabatti,manam evaritho closega untunnamo observe cheyali.

Oka simple question ask cheskovachu.Ee friendship valla nenu better person avuthunnana?Leda constantly stressed and uncomfortablega feel avuthunnana?

Answer chala things explain chestundi.

Friendship should give support,not constant pressure.

Manam friends ni choose cheskune freedom undi.Alage friends kuda manalni choose chestaru.

Anduke good friendship lo trust,respect and healthy influence undali.

Eventually,good friends mana life ni control cheyaru.They help us become better versions of ourselves.

Friends' influence గురించి ఇంకో point,choosing your circle గురించి.Time గడిచేకొద్దీ,manam ఎవరితో time spend చేస్తామో,ఆ selection ni consciously చేయడం important అవుతుంది.Chinnappudు friends usually circumstances valla,school leda neighborhood valla dorుకుతారు.Kaani పెద్దయ్యాక,మనం మన values మరియు goals తో align అయ్యే people ni select చేసుకునే freedom ఉంటుంది.Alage quality over quantity అనేది friendship లో కూడా apply అవుతుంది.Konni close,genuine friends,chala mandi superficial friends కంటే better.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,మనం ఎవరితో ఉంటామో,ఆ selection మన future ని కూడా shape చేస్తుంది.Finally,మంచి circle ఎంచుకోవడం అనేది ఒక skill,and ఆ skill practice తో develop అవుతుంది.

script60.title: Keeping Relationships Strong
script60.content:
Friendship start cheyadam easy.Maintain cheyadam konchem difficult.

First days lo friendship automaticga strongga untundi.Everything newga untundi.Every day matladukuntam.Kaani time pass ayina tarvata relationship ni maintain cheyadaniki effort kavali.

Life busy ayina friends kosam little time create cheyali.Daily call possible kaakapovachu.Kaani occasional message pampinchachu.Ask how are you ani simplega adagachu.

Relationships lo biggest problem sometimes communication lack.

Oka friend message ki reply ivvaledu ani immediately they don't care about me ani assume cheyakudadu.Maybe vallaki work undochu,vallaki personal problem undochu leda simply busyga undochu.

Assumptions kanna communication better.

Alage arguments jariginappudu ego tho silentga undipovadam relationship ni inka damage chestundi.Something wrong anipisthe calmga matladali.

Sorry cheppadam weakness kaadu.Mana mistake unte accept cheyadam maturity.

Kaani relationship maintain cheyadaniki only one person effort pettakudadu.Both sides effort undali.

Friendship lo boundaries kuda important.Everything share cheyalsina avasaram ledu.Personal space ivvali.

Oka friend ki own problems unte,manam every problem solve cheyalsina avasaram ledu.Sometimes just listen cheyadam kuda enough.

Life lo priorities change ayina relationships ni completely forget cheyakudadu.

Marriage,job,family and responsibilities vachina tarvata friendship time taggachu.Kaani genuine friends ni occasionalga contact lo unchukunte connection continue avuthundi.

Naaku anipisthundi strong relationships daily conversations valla maatrame create avvavu.Trust,respect,understanding and memories valla create avuthayi.

Years matladakapoyina,malli kalisinappudu comfortablega feel ayithe,adi genuine connection.

Finally,friendship ante always togetherga undadam kaadu.Sometimes distance lo unna kuda,manam okariki okaram important ani feel avvadam.

\*\*Good relationships don't need constant attention,but they do need genuine care.\*\*

Keeping relationships strong గురించి ఇంకో final point,celebrating small moments గురించి.Big events matrame కాదు,చిన్న చిన్న moments కూడా relationships ni strengthen చేస్తాయి.Oka simple message,oka surprise call,leda oka small gesture,ivi friendship లో value add చేస్తాయి.Alage gratitude express చేయడం కూడా important,friends కి వాళ్ళు మనకి ఎంత మీన్ చేస్తారో occasionally cheppadam relationship ni deepen చేస్తుంది.Naaku అనిపిస్తుంది,strong relationships ki grand gestures అవసరం లేదు,consistent,genuine care సరిపోతుంది.Finally,friendship అనేది ఒక garden లాంటిది,దానికి regular attention avసరం,కానీ ఆ care valla దొరికే connection,ఏ material thing తో కూడా compare చేయలేనిది.
